 611def calculate_glaciermelt(ds, parameter, prints=True):
 612    """
 613    Calculates accumulation, snow and ice melt, and runoff rates from glaciers using a Degree Day Model (DDM).
 614    This method is inspired by PYPDD (github.com/juseg/pypdd) and includes glacier storage-release dynamics.
 615
 616    Parameters
 617    ----------
 618    ds : xarray.Dataset
 619        Input dataset containing daily climate variables:
 620            - `temp_mean`: Daily mean temperature in °C.
 621            - `RRR`: Total precipitation in mm.
 622            - `snow`: Daily snowfall in mm.
 623            - `rain`: Daily rainfall in mm.
 624            - `pdd`: Positive degree day values (°C·days).
 625    parameter : pandas.Series
 626        Series of MATILDA parameters containing:
 627            - `CFMAX_snow`: Degree-day factor for snowmelt.
 628            - `CFMAX_ice`: Degree-day factor for ice melt.
 629            - `CFR`: Refreezing factor for snowmelt.
 630            - `CFR_ice`: Refreezing factor for ice melt.
 631            - `AG`: Glacier outflow adjustment parameter.
 632    prints : bool, optional
 633        If True, prints status updates during the calculation. Defaults to True.
 634
 635    Returns
 636    -------
 637    pandas.DataFrame
 638        A DataFrame containing daily values for various outputs of the Degree Day Model:
 639            - `DDM_smb`: Surface mass balance (mm w.e.).
 640            - `pdd`: Positive degree days (°C·days).
 641            - `DDM_temp`: Daily mean temperature (°C).
 642            - `DDM_prec`: Total precipitation (mm).
 643            - `DDM_rain`: Rainfall (mm).
 644            - `DDM_snow`: Snowfall (mm).
 645            - `DDM_accumulation_rate`: Snow accumulation rate (mm).
 646            - `DDM_ice_melt`: Ice melt (mm).
 647            - `DDM_snow_melt`: Snow melt (mm).
 648            - `DDM_total_melt`: Total melt (mm).
 649            - `DDM_refreezing`: Total refreezing (mm).
 650            - `DDM_glacier_reservoir`: Water stored in the glacier reservoir (mm).
 651            - `Q_DDM`: Actual runoff from the glacier (mm).
 652
 653    References
 654    ----------
 655    - PYPDD (github.com/juseg/pypdd)
 656    - Stahl, K., Moore, R. D., & McKendry, I. G. (2008). The role of synoptic-scale circulation in the linkage between large-scale ocean-atmosphere indices and winter surface climate in British Columbia, Canada. *Water Resources Research*, 44(7). https://doi.org/10.1029/2007WR005956
 657    - Toum, J., et al. (2021). Understanding glacier mass-balance variability using climate teleconnections. *The R Journal*, 13(1). https://doi.org/10.32614/RJ-2021-059
 658
 659    Notes
 660    -----
 661    This implementation uses a storage-release scheme for glacier outflow that adjusts based on snow depth
 662    and drainage system conditions.
 663    """
 664
 665    if prints:
 666        print("Calculating glacial melt")
 667
 668    # initialize arrays
 669    temp = ds["temp_mean"].values
 670    prec = ds["RRR"].values
 671    snow = ds["snow"].values
 672    rain = ds["rain"].values
 673    pdd = ds["pdd"].values
 674    snow_depth = []
 675    snow_melt = []
 676    ice_melt = []
 677    actual_runoff = []
 678    glacier_reservoir = []
 679
 680    accu_rate = snow
 681
 682    # compute snow depth and melt rates
 683    for i in range(len(temp)):
 684        if i > 0:
 685            snow_depth.append(snow_depth[i - 1])
 686            snow_depth[i] += accu_rate[i]
 687        else:
 688            snow_depth.append(accu_rate[i])
 689        snow_melt_tmp, ice_melt_tmp = melt_rates(snow_depth[i], pdd[i], parameter)
 690        snow_melt.append(snow_melt_tmp)
 691        ice_melt.append(ice_melt_tmp)
 692        snow_depth[i] -= snow_melt_tmp
 693
 694    # convert from list to array for arithmetic calculations
 695    snow_depth = np.array(snow_depth)  # not actual depth but mm w.e.!
 696    ice_melt = np.array(ice_melt)
 697    snow_melt = np.array(snow_melt)
 698
 699    # calculate refreezing, runoff and surface mass balance
 700    total_melt = snow_melt + ice_melt
 701    refr_ice = parameter.CFR_ice * ice_melt
 702    refr_snow = parameter.CFR * snow_melt
 703    refr_tot = refr_snow + refr_ice
 704    runoff_rate = total_melt - refr_tot
 705    inst_smb = accu_rate - runoff_rate
 706    runoff_rate_rain = runoff_rate + rain
 707
 708    # Storage-release scheme for glacier outflow (Stahl et.al. 2008, Toum et. al. 2021)
 709    KG_min = 0.1  # minimum outflow coefficient (conditions with deep snow and poorly developed glacial drainage systems) [time^−1]
 710    d_KG = 0.9  # KG_min + d_KG = maximum outflow coefficient (representing late-summer conditions with bare ice and a well developed glacial drainage system) [time^−1]
 711    KG = np.minimum(
 712        KG_min + d_KG * np.exp(snow_depth / -(0.1 * 1000000**parameter.AG)), 1
 713    )
 714    for i in np.arange(len(temp)):
 715        if i == 0:
 716            SG = runoff_rate_rain[i]  # liquid water stored in the reservoir
 717        else:
 718            SG = np.maximum((runoff_rate_rain[i] - actual_runoff[i - 1]) + SG, 0)
 719        actual_runoff.append(KG[i] * SG)
 720        glacier_reservoir.append(SG)
 721
 722    # final glacier module output (everything but temperature and pdd in mm w.e.)
 723    glacier_melt = xr.merge(
 724        [
 725            xr.DataArray(inst_smb, name="DDM_smb"),
 726            xr.DataArray(pdd, name="pdd"),
 727            xr.DataArray(temp, name="DDM_temp"),
 728            xr.DataArray(prec, name="DDM_prec"),
 729            xr.DataArray(rain, name="DDM_rain"),
 730            xr.DataArray(snow, name="DDM_snow"),
 731            xr.DataArray(accu_rate, name="DDM_accumulation_rate"),
 732            xr.DataArray(ice_melt, name="DDM_ice_melt"),
 733            xr.DataArray(snow_melt, name="DDM_snow_melt"),
 734            xr.DataArray(total_melt, name="DDM_total_melt"),
 735            xr.DataArray(refr_tot, name="DDM_refreezing"),
 736            xr.DataArray(glacier_reservoir, name="DDM_glacier_reservoir"),
 737            xr.DataArray(actual_runoff, name="Q_DDM"),
 738        ]
 739    )
 740
 741    DDM_results = glacier_melt.to_dataframe()
 742
 743    # merged data array comes without index -> set DateTime index from input
 744    idx = ds.coords.to_index()
 745    DDM_results = DDM_results.set_index(pd.DatetimeIndex(idx))
 746
 747    if prints:
 748        print("Finished Degree-Day Melt Routine")
 749
 750    return DDM_results
 751
 752
 753def create_lookup_table(glacier_profile, parameter):
 754    """
 755    Generates a lookup table of glacier area and water equivalent changes from the initial state (100% glacier coverage)
 756    to an ice-free state (0% coverage) using the deltaH scaling approach. This method is based on the routines outlined
 757    in Seibert et al. (2018) and Huss et al. (2010).
 758
 759    Parameters
 760    ----------
 761    glacier_profile : pandas.DataFrame
 762        DataFrame containing the glacier's initial state, including:
 763            - `Area`: Area of each elevation band (in km²).
 764            - `WE`: Initial water equivalent of each elevation band (in mm w.e.).
 765            - `Elevation`: Elevation of each band (in meters).
 766    parameter : pandas.Series
 767        Series of MATILDA parameters, including:
 768            - `area_glac`: Total glacier area (in km²).
 769
 770    Returns
 771    -------
 772    pandas.DataFrame
 773        Lookup table showing scaled glacier area for each elevation band over 101 mass states (from 100% to 0% in 1% steps).
 774        Each column corresponds to an elevation band (`EleZone`), and each row represents a scaled mass state.
 775
 776    References
 777    ----------
 778    - Huss, M., Jouvet, G., Farinotti, D., & Bauder, A. (2010). Future high-mountain hydrology: a new parameterization
 779      of glacier retreat. *Hydrology and Earth System Sciences, 14*(5), 815–829.
 780      https://doi.org/10.5194/hess-14-815-2010
 781    - Seibert, J., Vis, M. J. P., Kohn, I., Weiler, M., & Stahl, K. (2018). Technical note: Representing glacier geometry
 782      changes in a semi-distributed hydrological model. *Hydrology and Earth System Sciences, 22*(4), 2211–2224.
 783      https://doi.org/10.5194/hess-22-2211-2018
 784
 785    Notes
 786    -----
 787    1. The deltaH parameterization involves a scaling factor (`fs`) based on the total glacier mass change and the
 788       normalized elevation profile of the glacier.
 789    2. Three different parameter sets (`a`, `b`, `c`, `y`) are applied based on glacier size as outlined in Huss et al. (2010).
 790    3. Elevation bands with negative water equivalent are excluded iteratively during the scaling process.
 791    """
 792
 793    initial_area = glacier_profile["Area"]  # per elevation band
 794    hi_initial = glacier_profile[
 795        "WE"
 796    ]  # initial water equivalent of each elevation band
 797    hi_k = glacier_profile[
 798        "WE"
 799    ]  # hi_k is the updated water equivalent for each elevation zone, starts with initial values
 800    ai = glacier_profile[
 801        "Area"
 802    ]  # ai is the glacier area of each elevation zone, starts with initial values
 803
 804    lookup_table = pd.DataFrame()
 805    lookup_table = pd.concat(
 806        [lookup_table, initial_area.to_frame().T], ignore_index=True
 807    )
 808
 809    # Pre-simulation
 810    # 1. calculate total glacier mass in mm water equivalent: M = sum(ai * hi)
 811    m = sum(glacier_profile["Area"] * glacier_profile["WE"])
 812
 813    # melt the glacier in steps of 1 percent
 814    deltaM = -m / 100
 815
 816    # 2. Normalize glacier elevations: Einorm = (Emax-Ei)/(Emax-Emin)
 817    glacier_profile["norm_elevation"] = (
 818        glacier_profile["Elevation"].max() - glacier_profile["Elevation"]
 819    ) / (glacier_profile["Elevation"].max() - glacier_profile["Elevation"].min())
 820    # 3. Apply deltaH parameterization: deltahi = (Einorm+a)^y + b*(Einorm+a) + c
 821    # deltahi is the normalized (dimensionless) ice thickness change of elevation band i
 822    # choose one of the three parameterizations from Huss et al. (2010) depending on glacier size
 823    if parameter.area_glac < 5:
 824        a = -0.3
 825        b = 0.6
 826        c = 0.09
 827        y = 2
 828    elif parameter.area_glac < 20:
 829        a = -0.05
 830        b = 0.19
 831        c = 0.01
 832        y = 4
 833    else:
 834        a = -0.02
 835        b = 0.12
 836        c = 0
 837        y = 6
 838
 839    glacier_profile["delta_h"] = (
 840        (glacier_profile["norm_elevation"] + a) ** y
 841        + (b * (glacier_profile["norm_elevation"] + a))
 842        + c
 843    )
 844
 845    ai_scaled = ai.copy()  # initial values set as ai_scaled
 846
 847    fs = deltaM / (sum(ai * glacier_profile["delta_h"]))  # a) initial ai
 848
 849    for _ in range(99):
 850        # 5. compute glacier geometry for reduced mass
 851        hi_k = hi_k + fs * glacier_profile["delta_h"]
 852
 853        leftover = sum(
 854            pd.Series(np.where(hi_k < 0, hi_k, 0)) * ai
 855        )  # Calculate leftover (i.e. the 'negative' glacier volume)
 856
 857        hi_k = pd.Series(
 858            np.where(hi_k < 0, np.nan, hi_k)
 859        )  # Set those zones that have a negative we to NaN to make sure they will be excluded from now on
 860
 861        # 6. width scaling
 862        ai_scaled = ai * np.sqrt((hi_k / hi_initial))
 863
 864        # 7. create lookup table
 865        # glacier area for each elevation band for 101 different mass situations (100 percent to 0 in 1 percent steps)
 866
 867        lookup_table = pd.concat(
 868            [lookup_table, ai_scaled.to_frame().T], ignore_index=True
 869        )
 870
 871        if (
 872            sum(
 873                pd.Series(np.where(np.isnan(ai_scaled), 0, ai))
 874                * glacier_profile["delta_h"]
 875            )
 876            == 0
 877        ):
 878            ai_scaled = np.where(ai_scaled == 1, 1, 0)
 879        else:
 880            # Update fs (taking into account the leftover)
 881            fs = (deltaM + leftover) / sum(
 882                pd.Series(np.where(np.isnan(ai_scaled), 0, ai))
 883                * glacier_profile["delta_h"]
 884            )
 885
 886    lookup_table = lookup_table.fillna(0)
 887
 888    lookup_table.columns = glacier_profile["EleZone"]
 889    lookup_table = lookup_table.groupby(level=0, axis=1).sum()
 890
 891    elezones_inital = lookup_table.iloc[0]
 892
 893    lookup_table = lookup_table / elezones_inital
 894    lookup_table = round(lookup_table, 4)
 895    lookup_table.iloc[-1] = 0
 896    return lookup_table
 897
 898
 899def glacier_area_change(output_DDM, lookup_table, glacier_profile, parameter):
 900    """
 901    Calculates the new glacier area for each hydrological year and scales glacier variables using the deltaH scaling
 902    approach. This is the second part of the glacier scaling routine, based on Seibert et al. (2018) and Huss et al. (2010).
 903
 904    Parameters
 905    ----------
 906    output_DDM : pandas.DataFrame
 907        Degree Day Model (DDM) output containing surface mass balance (`DDM_smb`) and other glacier-related variables.
 908    lookup_table : pandas.DataFrame
 909        Lookup table created in part 1 of the scaling routine, mapping glacier area changes to mass loss percentages.
 910    glacier_profile : pandas.DataFrame
 911        DataFrame containing glacier initial states:
 912            - `Area`: Area of each elevation band (in km²).
 913            - `WE`: Initial water equivalent of each elevation band (in mm w.e.).
 914    parameter : pandas.Series
 915        Series of MATILDA parameters, including:
 916            - `area_glac`: Total glacier area (in km²).
 917            - `area_cat`: Catchment area (in km²).
 918            - `hydro_year`: Starting month of the hydrological year (1–12).
 919
 920    Returns
 921    -------
 922    tuple
 923        - `output_DDM` (pandas.DataFrame): Updated DDM output with scaled glacier variables for each hydrological year.
 924        - `glacier_change_area` (pandas.DataFrame): Time series of annual glacier area changes and cumulative scaled SMB.
 925
 926    References
 927    ----------
 928    - Huss, M., Jouvet, G., Farinotti, D., & Bauder, A. (2010). Future high-mountain hydrology: a new parameterization
 929      of glacier retreat. *Hydrology and Earth System Sciences, 14*(5), 815–829.
 930      https://doi.org/10.5194/hess-14-815-2010
 931    - Seibert, J., Vis, M. J. P., Kohn, I., Weiler, M., & Stahl, K. (2018). Technical note: Representing glacier geometry
 932      changes in a semi-distributed hydrological model. *Hydrology and Earth System Sciences, 22*(4), 2211–2224.
 933      https://doi.org/10.5194/hess-22-2211-2018
 934
 935    Notes
 936    -----
 937    1. The glacier area change is calculated annually based on the cumulative surface mass balance (SMB).
 938    2. SMB is scaled to the current glacier area to reflect its dynamic changes.
 939    3. If the cumulative SMB indicates a mass loss beyond 99% of the initial mass, the glacier area is set to zero.
 940    4. Variables in `output_DDM` are updated to reflect the new glacierized area fraction each year.
 941    """
 942
 943    # select output columns to update
 944    up_cols = output_DDM.columns.drop(["DDM_smb", "DDM_temp", "pdd"])
 945
 946    # creating columns for updated DDM output
 947    for col in up_cols:
 948        output_DDM[col + "_updated_scaled"] = copy.deepcopy(output_DDM[col])
 949
 950    # determining the hydrological year
 951    output_DDM["water_year"] = np.where(
 952        (output_DDM.index.month) >= parameter.hydro_year,
 953        output_DDM.index.year + 1,
 954        output_DDM.index.year,
 955    )
 956
 957    # initial glacier mass from the glacier profile in mm w.e. (relative to the whole catchment)
 958    m = sum((glacier_profile["Area"]) * glacier_profile["WE"])
 959
 960    # initial area
 961    initial_area = glacier_profile.groupby("EleZone")["Area"].sum()
 962
 963    # dataframe with the smb change per hydrological year in mm w.e.
 964    glacier_change = pd.DataFrame(
 965        {"smb": output_DDM.groupby("water_year")["DDM_smb"].sum()}
 966    ).reset_index()
 967
 968    initial_year = output_DDM["water_year"].iloc[0]
 969    glacier_change_area = pd.DataFrame(
 970        {"time": initial_year, "glacier_area": [parameter.area_glac]}
 971    )
 972
 973    # setting initial values for the loop
 974    new_area = parameter.area_glac
 975    smb_cum = 0
 976    i = 1
 977    for i in range(len(glacier_change)):
 978        year = glacier_change["water_year"][i]
 979        smb = glacier_change["smb"][i]
 980        # scale the smb to the (updated) glacierized fraction of the catchment
 981        smb = smb * (
 982            new_area / parameter.area_cat
 983        )  # SMB is area (re-)scaled because m is area scaled as well
 984        # add the smb from the previous year(s) to the new year
 985        smb_cum = smb_cum + smb
 986        # calculate the percentage of melt in comparison to the initial mass
 987        smb_percentage = round((-smb_cum / m) * 100)
 988        if (smb_percentage <= 99) & (smb_percentage >= 0):
 989            # select the correct row from the lookup table depending on the smb
 990            area_melt = lookup_table.iloc[smb_percentage]
 991            # derive the new glacier area by multiplying the initial area with the area changes
 992            new_area = (
 993                np.nansum((area_melt.values * initial_area.values)) * parameter.area_cat
 994            )
 995        else:
 996            new_area = 0
 997        # scale the output with the new glacierized area
 998        glacier_change_area = pd.concat([glacier_change_area,
 999            pd.DataFrame([{"time": year, "glacier_area": new_area, "smb_scaled_cum": smb_cum}])
1000            ], ignore_index=True)
1001        for col in up_cols:
1002            output_DDM[col + "_updated_scaled"] = np.where(
1003                output_DDM["water_year"] == year,
1004                output_DDM[col] * (new_area / parameter.area_cat),
1005                output_DDM[col + "_updated_scaled"],
1006            )
1007
1008        glacier_change_area["time"] = pd.to_datetime(
1009            glacier_change_area["time"], format="%Y"
1010        )
1011        glacier_change_area.set_index("time", inplace=True, drop=False)
1012        glacier_change_area["time"] = glacier_change_area["time"].dt.strftime("%Y")
1013        glacier_change = glacier_change.rename_axis("TIMESTAMP")
1014
1015    return output_DDM, glacier_change_area
1016
1017
1018def updated_glacier_melt(
1019    data, lookup_table, glacier_profile, parameter, drop_surplus=False
1020):
1021    """
1022    Calculates the new glacier area for each hydrological year and scales glacier variables using the deltaH scaling
1023    approach. This is the second part of the glacier scaling routine, based on Seibert et al. (2018) and Huss et al. (2010).
1024
1025    Parameters
1026    ----------
1027    output_DDM : pandas.DataFrame
1028        Degree Day Model (DDM) output containing surface mass balance (`DDM_smb`) and other glacier-related variables.
1029    lookup_table : pandas.DataFrame
1030        Lookup table created in part 1 of the scaling routine, mapping glacier area changes to mass loss percentages.
1031    glacier_profile : pandas.DataFrame
1032        DataFrame containing glacier initial states:
1033            - `Area`: Area of each elevation band (in km²).
1034            - `WE`: Initial water equivalent of each elevation band (in mm w.e.).
1035    parameter : pandas.Series
1036        Series of MATILDA parameters, including:
1037            - `area_glac`: Total glacier area (in km²).
1038            - `area_cat`: Catchment area (in km²).
1039            - `hydro_year`: Starting month of the hydrological year (1–12).
1040
1041    Returns
1042    -------
1043    tuple
1044        - `output_DDM` (pandas.DataFrame): Updated DDM output with scaled glacier variables for each hydrological year.
1045        - `glacier_change_area` (pandas.DataFrame): Time series of annual glacier area changes and cumulative scaled SMB.
1046
1047    References
1048    ----------
1049    - Huss, M., Jouvet, G., Farinotti, D., & Bauder, A. (2010). Future high-mountain hydrology: a new parameterization
1050      of glacier retreat. *Hydrology and Earth System Sciences, 14*(5), 815–829.
1051      https://doi.org/10.5194/hess-14-815-2010
1052    - Seibert, J., Vis, M. J. P., Kohn, I., Weiler, M., & Stahl, K. (2018). Technical note: Representing glacier geometry
1053      changes in a semi-distributed hydrological model. *Hydrology and Earth System Sciences, 22*(4), 2211–2224.
1054      https://doi.org/10.5194/hess-22-2211-2018
1055
1056    Notes
1057    -----
1058    1. The glacier area change is calculated annually based on the cumulative surface mass balance (SMB).
1059    2. SMB is scaled to the current glacier area to reflect its dynamic changes.
1060    3. If the cumulative SMB indicates a mass loss beyond 99% of the initial mass, the glacier area is set to zero.
1061    4. Variables in `output_DDM` are updated to reflect the new glacierized area fraction each year.
1062    """
1063
1064    # determine hydrological years
1065    data["water_year"] = np.where(
1066        (data.index.month) >= parameter.hydro_year, data.index.year + 1, data.index.year
1067    )
1068
1069    # initial glacier mass from the glacier profile in mm w.e. (relative to the whole catchment)
1070    m = np.nansum((glacier_profile["Area"]) * glacier_profile["WE"])
1071
1072    # initial area
1073    initial_area = glacier_profile.groupby("EleZone")["Area"].sum()
1074
1075    # re-calculate the mean glacier elevation based on the glacier profile in rough elevation zones for consistency (method outlined in following loop)
1076    print("Recalculating initial elevations based on glacier profile")
1077    init_dist = (
1078        initial_area.values / initial_area.values.sum()
1079    )  # fractions of glacierized area elev zones
1080    init_elev = (
1081        init_dist * lookup_table.columns.values
1082    )  # multiply fractions with average zone elevations
1083    init_elev = int(init_elev.sum())
1084    print(">> Prior glacier elevation: " + str(parameter.ele_glac) + "m a.s.l.")
1085    print(">> Recalculated glacier elevation: " + str(init_elev) + "m a.s.l.")
1086
1087    # re-calculate the mean non-glacierized elevation accordingly
1088    if parameter.ele_cat is None:
1089        ele_non_glac = None
1090    else:
1091        ele_non_glac = (
1092            (parameter.ele_cat - parameter.area_glac / parameter.area_cat * init_elev)
1093            * parameter.area_cat
1094            / (parameter.area_cat - parameter.area_glac)
1095        )
1096    if ele_non_glac is not None:
1097        print(
1098            ">> Prior non-glacierized elevation: "
1099            + str(round(parameter.ele_non_glac))
1100            + "m a.s.l."
1101        )
1102        print(
1103            ">> Recalculated non-glacierized elevation: "
1104            + str(round(ele_non_glac))
1105            + "m a.s.l."
1106        )
1107
1108    # Setup initial variables for main loop
1109    new_area = parameter.area_glac
1110    smb_cum = 0
1111    surplus = 0
1112    warn = True
1113    output_DDM = pd.DataFrame()
1114    parameter_updated = copy.deepcopy(parameter)
1115    parameter_updated.ele_glac = init_elev
1116    parameter_updated.ele_non_glac = ele_non_glac
1117
1118    # create initial non-updated dataframes
1119    input_df_glacier, input_df_catchment = input_scaling(data, parameter_updated)
1120
1121    # Slice input data to simulation period (with full hydrological years if the setup period allows it)
1122    if datetime.fromisoformat(parameter.sim_start).month < parameter.hydro_year:
1123        startyear = data[parameter.sim_start : parameter.sim_end].water_year[0] - 1
1124    else:
1125        startyear = data[parameter.sim_start : parameter.sim_end].water_year[0]
1126
1127    startdate = str(startyear) + "-" + str(parameter.hydro_year) + "-" + "01"
1128
1129    if datetime.fromisoformat(startdate) < datetime.fromisoformat(
1130        parameter.set_up_start
1131    ):
1132        # Provided setup period does not cover the full hydrological year sim_start is in
1133        data_update = data[parameter.sim_start : parameter.sim_end]
1134        input_df_glacier = input_df_glacier[parameter.sim_start : parameter.sim_end]
1135        input_df_catchment_spinup = input_df_catchment[
1136            parameter.set_up_start : parameter.sim_start
1137        ]
1138        input_df_catchment = input_df_catchment[parameter.sim_start : parameter.sim_end]
1139
1140        print(
1141            "**********\n"
1142            "WARNING!\n"
1143            "The provided setup period does not cover the full hydrological year the simulation period \n"
1144            "starts in. The initial surface mass balance (SMB) of the first hydrological year in the glacier \n"
1145            "rescaling routine therefore possibly misses a significant part of the accumulation period (e.g. Oct-Dec).\n"
1146            "**********\n"
1147        )
1148    else:
1149        data_update = data[startdate : parameter.sim_end]
1150        input_df_glacier = input_df_glacier[startdate : parameter.sim_end]
1151        input_df_catchment_spinup = input_df_catchment[
1152            parameter.set_up_start : startdate
1153        ]
1154        input_df_catchment = input_df_catchment[startdate : parameter.sim_end]
1155
1156    # create initial df of glacier change
1157    glacier_change = pd.DataFrame(
1158        {
1159            "time": startyear,
1160            "glacier_area": [parameter.area_glac],
1161            "glacier_elev": init_elev,
1162        }
1163    )
1164
1165    # Loop through simulation period annually updating catchment fractions and scaling elevations
1166    if parameter.ele_dat is None:
1167        raise ValueError(
1168            "You need to provide ele_dat in order to apply the glacier-rescaling routine."
1169        )
1170    print("Calculating glacier evolution")
1171    for i in range(len(data_update.water_year.unique())):
1172        year = data_update.water_year.unique()[i]
1173        mask = data_update.water_year == year
1174
1175        # Use updated glacier area of the previous year
1176        parameter_updated.area_glac = new_area
1177        # Use updated glacier elevation of the previous year
1178        if i != 0:
1179            parameter_updated.ele_glac = new_distribution
1180
1181        # Calculate the updated mean elevation of the non-glacierized catchment area
1182        if parameter_updated.ele_cat is None:
1183            parameter_updated.ele_non_glac = None
1184        else:
1185            parameter_updated.ele_non_glac = (
1186                (
1187                    parameter_updated.ele_cat
1188                    - parameter_updated.area_glac
1189                    / parameter_updated.area_cat
1190                    * parameter_updated.ele_glac
1191                )
1192                * parameter_updated.area_cat
1193                / (parameter_updated.area_cat - parameter_updated.area_glac)
1194            )
1195
1196        # Scale glacier and hbv routine inputs in selected year with updated parameters
1197        input_df_glacier[mask], input_df_catchment[mask] = input_scaling(
1198            data_update[mask], parameter_updated
1199        )
1200
1201        # Calculate positive degree days and glacier ablation/accumulation
1202        degreedays_ds = calculate_PDD(input_df_glacier[mask], prints=False)
1203        output_DDM_year = calculate_glaciermelt(
1204            degreedays_ds, parameter_updated, prints=False
1205        )
1206        output_DDM_year["water_year"] = data_update.water_year[mask]
1207
1208        # deselect output columns not to update
1209        up_cols = output_DDM_year.columns.drop(
1210            ["DDM_smb", "DDM_temp", "pdd", "water_year"]
1211        )
1212
1213        # create columns for updated DDM output
1214        for col in up_cols:
1215            output_DDM_year[col + "_updated_scaled"] = copy.deepcopy(
1216                output_DDM_year[col]
1217            )
1218
1219        # Rescale glacier geometry and update glacier parameters in all but the last (incomplete) water year
1220        if i < len(data_update.water_year.unique()) - 1:
1221
1222            smb_unscaled = output_DDM_year["DDM_smb"].sum()
1223
1224            # if True: model runs with positive MB_cum at any time are 'dropped' (runoff = 0.01, SMB 9999)
1225            if drop_surplus:
1226
1227                if i == 0 and smb_unscaled > 0:
1228                    print(
1229                        "**********\n"
1230                        "WARNING:\n"
1231                        "The cumulative surface mass balance in the first year of the simulation period is \n"
1232                        "positive. You may want to shift the starting year or set drop_surplus=False.\n"
1233                        "**********\n"
1234                    )
1235                # scale the smb to the (updated) glacierized fraction of the catchment
1236                smb = smb_unscaled * (
1237                    new_area / parameter.area_cat
1238                )  # SMB is area (re-)scaled because m is area scaled as well
1239                # add the smb from the previous year(s) to the new year
1240                smb_cum = smb_cum + smb
1241                if smb_cum > 0:
1242                    if warn:
1243                        print(
1244                            "**********\n"
1245                            "WARNING:\n"
1246                            "The cumulative surface mass balance in the simulation period is positive. \n"
1247                            "The glacier rescaling routine cannot model glacier extent exceeding the initial status of \n"
1248                            "the provided glacier profile. In order to exclude this run from parameter optimization \n"
1249                            "routines, a flag is passed, simulated runoff is set to 0.01, and SMB to 9999. \n"
1250                            "If you want to maintain the average mass balance set drop_surplus=False.\n"
1251                            "**********\n"
1252                        )
1253                        warn = False
1254                    smb_cum = m
1255                    new_distribution = parameter.ele_glac
1256                    smb_flag = True
1257                else:
1258                    smb_flag = False
1259
1260            # if drop_surplus = False the surplus from years with positive MB_cum is added in later years
1261            else:
1262                # scale the smb to the (updated) glacierized fraction of the catchment
1263                smb = smb_unscaled * (
1264                    new_area / parameter.area_cat
1265                )  # SMB is area (re-)scaled because m is area scaled as well
1266                smb_scaled = smb.copy()
1267
1268                # If the cumulative SMB has been positive in previous years the surplus is added here
1269                if surplus > 0:
1270                    if smb < 0:
1271                        diff = surplus + smb
1272                        surplus = max(diff, 0)
1273                        smb = min(diff, 0)
1274                # add the smb from the previous year(s) to the new year
1275                smb_cum = smb_cum + smb
1276                # Check whether glacier extent exceeds the initial state (smb_cum > 0). Shift surplus to next year(s).
1277                if smb_cum > 0:
1278                    if warn:
1279                        print(
1280                            "**********\n"
1281                            "WARNING:\n"
1282                            "At some point of the simulation period the cumulative surface mass balance is\n"
1283                            " positive. The glacier rescaling routine cannot model glacier extent exceeding the initial\n"
1284                            " status of the provided glacier profile. The surplus is stored and added in subsequent years\n"
1285                            " with negative mass balance(s) to maintain the long-term average balance.\n"
1286                            "**********\n"
1287                        )
1288                        warn = False
1289                    surplus += max(smb_cum, 0)
1290                    smb_cum = 0
1291
1292                smb_flag = False
1293
1294            # calculate the percentage of melt in comparison to the initial mass
1295            smb_percentage = round((-smb_cum / m) * 100)
1296            if (smb_percentage < 99) & (smb_percentage >= 0):
1297                # select the correct row from the lookup table depending on the smb
1298                area_melt = lookup_table.iloc[smb_percentage]
1299                # derive the new glacier area by multiplying the initial area with the area changes
1300                new_area = (
1301                    np.nansum((area_melt.values * initial_area.values))
1302                    * parameter.area_cat
1303                )
1304                # derive new spatial distribution of glacierized area (relative fraction in every elevation zone)
1305                new_distribution = (
1306                    (area_melt.values * initial_area.values) * parameter.area_cat
1307                ) / new_area
1308                # multiply relative portions with mean zone elevations to get rough estimate for new mean elevation
1309                new_distribution = (
1310                    new_distribution * lookup_table.columns.values
1311                )  # column headers contain elevations
1312                new_distribution = int(np.nansum(new_distribution))
1313            else:
1314                new_area = 0
1315
1316            glacier_mass_abs = (1 - smb_percentage * 0.01) * m
1317            glacier_vol_init = (
1318                (m / 1000) * parameter.area_glac * 1e6 / 0.908
1319            )  # mass in mmwe, area in km^2
1320            glacier_vol = (glacier_mass_abs / 1000) * new_area * 1e6 / 0.908
1321            glacier_vol_perc = glacier_vol / glacier_vol_init
1322
1323            # Append to glacier change dataframe for subsequent functions (skip last incomplete year)
1324            data = {
1325                "time": year,
1326                "glacier_area": new_area,
1327                "glacier_elev": new_distribution,
1328                "smb_water_year": smb_unscaled,
1329            }
1330
1331            if drop_surplus:
1332                data["smb_scaled_cum"] = smb_cum
1333            else:
1334                data.update(
1335                    {
1336                        "smb_scaled": smb_scaled,
1337                        "smb_scaled_capped": smb,
1338                        "smb_scaled_capped_cum": smb_cum,
1339                        "surplus": surplus,
1340                        "glacier_melt_perc": smb_percentage,
1341                        "glacier_mass_mmwe": glacier_mass_abs,
1342                        "glacier_vol_m3": glacier_vol,
1343                        "glacier_vol_perc": glacier_vol_perc,
1344                    }
1345                )
1346
1347            # Create the DataFrame and concatenate
1348            new_row = pd.DataFrame(data, index=[i])
1349            glacier_change = pd.concat([glacier_change, new_row], ignore_index=True)
1350
1351        # Scale DDM output to new glacierized fraction
1352        for col in up_cols:
1353            output_DDM_year[col + "_updated_scaled"] = np.where(
1354                output_DDM_year["water_year"] == year,
1355                output_DDM_year[col] * (new_area / parameter.area_cat),
1356                output_DDM_year[col + "_updated_scaled"],
1357            )
1358        # Append year to full dataset
1359        output_DDM = pd.concat([output_DDM, output_DDM_year])
1360
1361        if smb_flag:
1362            output_DDM["smb_flag"] = 1
1363            output_DDM["DDM_smb"] = (
1364                9999  # To exclude run from parameter optimization of glacial parameters
1365            )
1366
1367    glacier_change["time"] = pd.to_datetime(glacier_change["time"], format="%Y")
1368    glacier_change.set_index("time", inplace=True, drop=False)
1369    glacier_change["time"] = glacier_change["time"].dt.strftime("%Y")
1370    glacier_change = glacier_change.rename_axis("TIMESTAMP")
1371
1372    output_DDM = output_DDM[parameter.sim_start : parameter.sim_end]
1373    # Add original spin-up period back to HBV input
1374    input_df_catchment = pd.concat([input_df_catchment_spinup, input_df_catchment])
1375
1376    return output_DDM, glacier_change, input_df_catchment
1377
1378
1379def hbv_simulation(input_df_catchment, parameter, glacier_area=None):
1380    """
1381    Simulates runoff from a catchment using the HBV model. Calculates key hydrological processes, including snowmelt,
1382    evaporation, soil moisture, and groundwater flow, based on input climate data and parameters.
1383
1384    The Python code is adapted from the LHMP hydrological modeling playground
1385    (github.com/hydrogo/LHMP, Ayzel Georgy. (2016). doi:10.5281/zenodo.59501).
1386    Evapotranspiration values are calculated using the method outlined in Oudin et al. (2005) if not provided in the input data.
1387
1388    Parameters
1389    ----------
1390    input_df_catchment : pandas.DataFrame
1391        Input climate dataset with daily resolution, including:
1392            - `T2`: Temperature (°C).
1393            - `RRR`: Total precipitation (mm).
1394            - `rain`: Rainfall (mm).
1395            - `snow`: Snowfall (mm).
1396            - `PE` (optional): Potential evapotranspiration (mm).
1397    parameter : pandas.Series
1398        Series of HBV model parameters, including:
1399            - `CFMAX_snow`: Degree-day factor for snowmelt.
1400            - `CFR`: Refreezing factor for snowmelt.
1401            - `TT_snow`: Threshold temperature for snowmelt.
1402            - `CWH`: Water holding capacity of snowpack.
1403            - `FC`: Field capacity of the soil.
1404            - `LP`: Soil moisture threshold for potential evapotranspiration.
1405            - `BETA`: Shape parameter for soil moisture recharge.
1406            - `PERC`: Percolation rate from upper to lower groundwater box.
1407            - `K0`, `K1`, `K2`: Recession coefficients for runoff components.
1408            - `UZL`: Threshold for upper groundwater runoff.
1409            - `CET`: Correction factor for evapotranspiration.
1410            - `MAXBAS`: Parameter for hydrograph smoothing.
1411            - `area_cat`: Total catchment area (km²).
1412            - `area_glac`: Glacierized area within the catchment (km²).
1413            - `lat`: Latitude of the catchment for radiation calculations.
1414            - `sim_start`, `sim_end`: Simulation period (YYYY-MM-DD).
1415            - `set_up_start`, `set_up_end`: Setup period (YYYY-MM-DD).
1416    glacier_area : pandas.DataFrame, optional
1417        Time series of annual glacier areas for dynamically scaling snow and rain fractions. Defaults to None.
1418
1419    Returns
1420    -------
1421    pandas.DataFrame
1422        A DataFrame containing simulated hydrological variables and runoff, including:
1423            - `HBV_temp`: Input temperature (°C).
1424            - `HBV_prec`: Input precipitation (mm).
1425            - `HBV_rain`: Rainfall off-glacier (mm).
1426            - `HBV_snow`: Snowfall off-glacier (mm).
1427            - `HBV_pe`: Potential evapotranspiration (mm).
1428            - `HBV_snowpack`: Snowpack water equivalent (mm).
1429            - `HBV_soil_moisture`: Soil moisture content (mm).
1430            - `HBV_AET`: Actual evapotranspiration (mm).
1431            - `HBV_refreezing`: Refreezing within the snowpack (mm).
1432            - `HBV_upper_gw`: Water in the upper groundwater box (mm).
1433            - `HBV_lower_gw`: Water in the lower groundwater box (mm).
1434            - `HBV_melt_off_glacier`: Meltwater runoff from snow and refreezing off-glacier (mm).
1435            - `Q_HBV`: Simulated catchment runoff (mm).
1436
1437    References
1438    ----------
1439    - Ayzel, G. (2016). LHMP: Lumped hydrological modeling playground.
1440      Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.59501
1441    - Oudin, L., Hervé, A., Perrin, C., Michel, C., Andréassian, V., Anctil, F., & Loumagne, C. (2005).
1442      Which potential evapotranspiration input for a lumped rainfall–runoff model?: Part 2—Towards a simple and efficient
1443      potential evapotranspiration model for rainfall–runoff modelling. *Journal of Hydrology, 303*(1), 290–306.
1444      https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jhydrol.2004.08.026
1445
1446    Notes
1447    -----
1448    1. Calculates potential evapotranspiration using Oudin et al. (2005) if not provided.
1449    2. Simulates snowmelt, soil moisture recharge, evaporation, and groundwater flow iteratively over the setup and simulation periods.
1450    3. Supports optional scaling of snow and rain fractions based on dynamically changing glacier areas.
1451    """
1452
1453    print("*-------------------*")
1454    print("Running HBV routine")
1455    # 1. new temporary dataframe from input with daily values
1456    if "PE" in input_df_catchment.columns:
1457        input_df_hbv = input_df_catchment.resample("D").agg(
1458            {"T2": "mean", "RRR": "sum", "rain": "sum", "snow": "sum", "PE": "sum"}
1459        )
1460    else:
1461        input_df_hbv = input_df_catchment.resample("D").agg(
1462            {"T2": "mean", "RRR": "sum", "rain": "sum", "snow": "sum"}
1463        )
1464
1465    Temp = input_df_hbv["T2"]
1466    Prec = input_df_hbv["RRR"]
1467    rain = input_df_hbv["rain"]
1468    snow = input_df_hbv["snow"]
1469
1470    # Calculation of PE with Oudin et al. 2005
1471    latent_heat_flux = 2.45
1472    water_density = 1000
1473    if "PE" in input_df_catchment.columns:
1474        Evap = input_df_hbv["PE"]
1475    else:
1476        doy = np.array(input_df_hbv.index.strftime("%j")).astype(int)
1477        lat = np.deg2rad(parameter.lat)
1478
1479        # Part 2. Extraterrestrial radiation calculation
1480        # set solar constant (in W m-2)
1481        Rsc = 1367  # solar constant (in W m-2)
1482        # calculate solar declination dt (in radians)
1483        dt = 0.409 * np.sin(2 * np.pi / 365 * doy - 1.39)
1484        # calculate sunset hour angle (in radians)
1485        ws = np.arccos(-np.tan(lat) * np.tan(dt))
1486        # Calculate day angle j (in radians)
1487        j = 2 * np.pi / 365.25 * doy
1488        # Calculate relative distance to sun
1489        dr = 1.0 + 0.03344 * np.cos(j - 0.048869)
1490        # Calculate extraterrestrial radiation (J m-2 day-1)
1491        Re = (
1492            Rsc
1493            * 86400
1494            / np.pi
1495            * dr
1496            * (ws * np.sin(lat) * np.sin(dt) + np.sin(ws) * np.cos(lat) * np.cos(dt))
1497        )
1498        # convert from J m-2 day-1 to MJ m-2 day-1
1499        Re = Re / 10**6
1500
1501        Evap = np.where(
1502            Temp + 5 > 0,
1503            (Re / (water_density * latent_heat_flux)) * ((Temp + 5) / 100) * 1000,
1504            0,
1505        )
1506
1507        Evap = pd.Series(Evap, index=input_df_hbv.index)
1508        input_df_hbv["PE"] = Evap
1509
1510    # 2. Set-up period:
1511    # 2.1 meteorological forcing preprocessing
1512    Temp_cal = Temp[parameter.set_up_start : parameter.set_up_end]
1513    Prec_cal = Prec[parameter.set_up_start : parameter.set_up_end]
1514    SNOW_cal = snow[parameter.set_up_start : parameter.set_up_end]
1515    RAIN_cal = rain[parameter.set_up_start : parameter.set_up_end]
1516    Evap_cal = Evap[parameter.set_up_start : parameter.set_up_end]
1517
1518    # get the new glacier area for each year      --> I think this section is redundant. glacier_area does not cover the set_up period!
1519    if glacier_area is not None:
1520
1521        glacier_area = glacier_area.iloc[1:, :].copy()
1522        SNOW2 = pd.DataFrame(SNOW_cal)
1523        SNOW2["area"] = 0
1524        for year in range(len(glacier_area)):
1525            SNOW2["area"] = np.where(
1526                SNOW2.index.year == glacier_area["time"].iloc[year],
1527                glacier_area["glacier_area"].iloc[year],
1528                SNOW2["area"],
1529            )
1530
1531        SNOW2["snow"] = SNOW2["snow"] * (1 - (SNOW2["area"] / parameter.area_cat))
1532        SNOW_cal = SNOW2["snow"].squeeze()
1533        RAIN_cal = RAIN_cal * (1 - (SNOW2["area"] / parameter.area_cat))
1534        Prec_cal = Prec_cal * (1 - (SNOW2["area"] / parameter.area_cat))
1535    else:
1536        SNOW_cal = SNOW_cal * (1 - (parameter.area_glac / parameter.area_cat))
1537        RAIN_cal = RAIN_cal * (1 - (parameter.area_glac / parameter.area_cat))
1538        Prec_cal = Prec_cal * (1 - (parameter.area_glac / parameter.area_cat))
1539
1540    # evaporation correction
1541    # a. calculate long-term averages of daily temperature
1542    Temp_mean_cal = np.array(
1543        [Temp_cal.loc[Temp_cal.index.dayofyear == x].mean() for x in range(1, 367)]
1544    )
1545    # b. correction of Evaporation daily values
1546    Evap_cal = Evap_cal.index.map(
1547        lambda x: (1 + parameter.CET * (Temp_cal[x] - Temp_mean_cal[x.dayofyear - 1]))
1548        * Evap_cal[x]
1549    )
1550    # c. control Evaporation
1551    Evap_cal = np.where(Evap_cal > 0, Evap_cal, 0)
1552
1553    # 2.2 Initial parameter calibration
1554    # snowpack box
1555    SNOWPACK_cal = np.zeros(len(Prec_cal))
1556    SNOWPACK_cal[0] = 0.0001
1557    # meltwater box
1558    SNOWMELT_cal = np.zeros(len(Prec_cal))
1559    SNOWMELT_cal[0] = 0.0001
1560    # soil moisture box
1561    SM_cal = np.zeros(len(Prec_cal))
1562    SM_cal[0] = 0.0001
1563    # actual evaporation
1564    ETact_cal = np.zeros(len(Prec_cal))
1565    ETact_cal[0] = 0.0001
1566
1567    # 2.3 Running model for set-up period
1568    for t in range(1, len(Prec_cal)):
1569        # 2.3.1 Snow routine
1570        # how snowpack forms
1571        SNOWPACK_cal[t] = SNOWPACK_cal[t - 1] + SNOW_cal[t]
1572
1573        # how snowpack melts
1574        melt = max(0, parameter.CFMAX_snow * Temp_cal[t])  # control melting
1575        melt = min(melt, SNOWPACK_cal[t])  # limit by snowpack
1576
1577        # how meltwater box forms
1578        SNOWMELT_cal[t] = SNOWMELT_cal[t - 1] + melt
1579
1580        # snowpack after melting
1581        SNOWPACK_cal[t] -= melt
1582
1583        # refreezing accounting
1584        refreezing = (
1585            parameter.CFR * parameter.CFMAX_snow * (parameter.TT_snow - Temp_cal[t])
1586        )
1587        refreezing = max(0, refreezing)  # control refreezing
1588        refreezing = min(refreezing, SNOWMELT_cal[t])  # limit by meltwater
1589
1590        # snowpack after refreezing
1591        SNOWPACK_cal[t] += refreezing
1592
1593        # meltwater after refreezing
1594        SNOWMELT_cal[t] -= refreezing
1595
1596        # recharge to soil
1597        tosoil = max(
1598            0, SNOWMELT_cal[t] - (parameter.CWH * SNOWPACK_cal[t])
1599        )  # control recharge
1600
1601        # meltwater after recharge to soil
1602        SNOWMELT_cal[t] -= tosoil
1603
1604        # 2.3.1 Soil and evaporation routine
1605        # soil wetness calculation
1606        soil_wetness = (SM_cal[t - 1] / parameter.FC) ** parameter.BETA
1607        soil_wetness = max(0, min(1, soil_wetness))  # control soil wetness
1608
1609        # soil recharge
1610        recharge = (RAIN_cal[t] + tosoil) * soil_wetness
1611
1612        # soil moisture update
1613        SM_cal[t] = SM_cal[t - 1] + RAIN_cal[t] + tosoil - recharge
1614
1615        # excess of water calculation
1616        excess = max(0, SM_cal[t] - parameter.FC)  # control excess
1617
1618        # soil moisture update
1619        SM_cal[t] -= excess
1620
1621        # evaporation accounting
1622        evapfactor = SM_cal[t] / (parameter.LP * parameter.FC)
1623        evapfactor = max(0, min(1, evapfactor))  # control evapfactor in range [0, 1]
1624
1625        # calculate actual evaporation
1626        ETact_cal[t] = min(
1627            SM_cal[t], Evap_cal[t] * evapfactor
1628        )  # control actual evaporation
1629
1630        # last soil moisture updating
1631        SM_cal[t] -= ETact_cal[t]
1632
1633    print("Finished spin up for initial HBV parameters")
1634
1635    # 3. meteorological forcing preprocessing for simulation
1636    Temp = Temp[parameter.sim_start : parameter.sim_end]
1637    Prec = Prec[parameter.sim_start : parameter.sim_end]
1638    SNOW = snow[parameter.sim_start : parameter.sim_end]
1639    RAIN = rain[parameter.sim_start : parameter.sim_end]
1640    Evap = Evap[parameter.sim_start : parameter.sim_end]
1641
1642    # get the new glacier area for each year
1643    if glacier_area is not None:
1644        glacier_area = glacier_area.iloc[1:, :].copy()
1645        SNOW2 = pd.DataFrame(SNOW)
1646        SNOW2["area"] = 0
1647        for year in range(len(glacier_area)):
1648            SNOW2["area"] = np.where(
1649                SNOW2.index.year == glacier_area["time"].iloc[year],
1650                glacier_area["glacier_area"].iloc[year],
1651                SNOW2["area"],
1652            )
1653        RAIN = RAIN * (1 - (SNOW2["area"] / parameter.area_cat))  # Rain off glacier
1654        SNOW2["snow"] = SNOW2["snow"] * (
1655            1 - (SNOW2["area"] / parameter.area_cat)
1656        )  # Snow off-glacier
1657        SNOW = SNOW2["snow"].squeeze()
1658        Prec = Prec * (1 - (SNOW2["area"] / parameter.area_cat))
1659
1660    else:
1661        RAIN = RAIN * (
1662            1 - (parameter.area_glac / parameter.area_cat)
1663        )  # Rain off glacier
1664        SNOW = SNOW * (
1665            1 - (parameter.area_glac / parameter.area_cat)
1666        )  # Snow off-glacier
1667        Prec = Prec * (1 - (parameter.area_glac / parameter.area_cat))
1668
1669    # a. calculate long-term averages of daily temperature
1670    Temp_mean = np.array(
1671        [Temp.loc[Temp.index.dayofyear == x].mean() for x in range(1, 367)]
1672    )
1673    # b. correction of Evaporation daily values
1674    Evap = Evap.index.map(
1675        lambda x: (1 + parameter.CET * (Temp[x] - Temp_mean[x.dayofyear - 1])) * Evap[x]
1676    )
1677    # c. control Evaporation
1678    Evap = np.where(Evap > 0, Evap, 0)
1679
1680    # 4. initialize boxes and initial conditions after calibration
1681    # snowpack box
1682    SNOWPACK = np.zeros(len(Prec))
1683    SNOWPACK[0] = SNOWPACK_cal[-1]
1684    # meltwater box
1685    SNOWMELT = np.zeros(len(Prec))
1686    SNOWMELT[0] = 0.0001
1687    # total melt off-glacier --> added to write daily output
1688    off_glac = np.zeros(len(Prec))
1689    off_glac[0] = 0.0001
1690    # refreezing  --> added to write daily output
1691    refreezing_off_glacier = np.zeros(len(Prec))
1692    refreezing_off_glacier[0] = 0.0001
1693    # soil moisture box
1694    SM = np.zeros(len(Prec))
1695    SM[0] = SM_cal[-1]
1696    # soil upper zone box
1697    SUZ = np.zeros(len(Prec))
1698    SUZ[0] = 0.0001
1699    # soil lower zone box
1700    SLZ = np.zeros(len(Prec))
1701    SLZ[0] = 0.0001
1702    # actual evaporation
1703    ETact = np.zeros(len(Prec))
1704    ETact[0] = 0.0001
1705    # simulated runoff box
1706    Qsim = np.zeros(len(Prec))
1707    Qsim[0] = 0.0001
1708
1709    # 5. The main cycle of calculations
1710    for t in range(1, len(Qsim)):
1711        # 5.1 Snow routine
1712        # how snowpack forms
1713        SNOWPACK[t] = SNOWPACK[t - 1] + SNOW[t]
1714
1715        # how snowpack melts
1716        melt = max(0, parameter.CFMAX_snow * Temp[t])  # control melting
1717        melt = min(melt, SNOWPACK[t])  # limit by snowpack
1718
1719        # how meltwater box forms
1720        SNOWMELT[t] = SNOWMELT[t - 1] + melt
1721
1722        # snowpack after melting
1723        SNOWPACK[t] -= melt
1724
1725        # refreezing accounting
1726        refreezing = (
1727            parameter.CFR * parameter.CFMAX_snow * (parameter.TT_snow - Temp[t])
1728        )
1729        refreezing = max(0, refreezing)  # control refreezing
1730        refreezing = min(refreezing, SNOWMELT[t])  # limit by meltwater
1731
1732        # write refreezing to output
1733        refreezing_off_glacier[t] = refreezing
1734
1735        # snowpack after refreezing
1736        SNOWPACK[t] += refreezing
1737
1738        # meltwater after refreezing
1739        SNOWMELT[t] -= refreezing
1740
1741        # write total melt off-glacier to output
1742        off_glac[t] = max(melt - refreezing, 0)
1743
1744        # recharge to soil
1745        tosoil = max(0, SNOWMELT[t] - (parameter.CWH * SNOWPACK[t]))  # control recharge
1746
1747        # meltwater after recharge to soil
1748        SNOWMELT[t] -= tosoil
1749
1750        # 5.2 Soil and evaporation routine
1751        # soil wetness calculation
1752        soil_wetness = (SM[t - 1] / parameter.FC) ** parameter.BETA
1753        soil_wetness = max(
1754            0, min(1, soil_wetness)
1755        )  # control soil wetness in range [0, 1]
1756
1757        # soil recharge
1758        recharge = (RAIN[t] + tosoil) * soil_wetness
1759
1760        # soil moisture update
1761        SM[t] = SM[t - 1] + RAIN[t] + tosoil - recharge
1762
1763        # excess of water calculation
1764        excess = max(0, SM[t] - parameter.FC)  # control excess
1765
1766        # soil moisture update
1767        SM[t] -= excess
1768
1769        # evaporation accounting
1770        evapfactor = SM[t] / (parameter.LP * parameter.FC)
1771        evapfactor = max(0, min(1, evapfactor))  # control evapfactor in range [0, 1]
1772
1773        # calculate actual evaporation
1774        ETact[t] = min(SM[t], Evap[t] * evapfactor)  # control actual evaporation
1775
1776        # last soil moisture updating
1777        SM[t] -= ETact[t]
1778
1779        # 5.3 Groundwater routine
1780        # upper groundwater box
1781        SUZ[t] = SUZ[t - 1] + recharge + excess
1782
1783        # percolation control
1784        perc = min(SUZ[t], parameter.PERC)
1785
1786        # update upper groundwater box
1787        SUZ[t] -= perc
1788
1789        # runoff from the highest part of upper groundwater box (surface runoff)
1790        Q0 = parameter.K0 * max(SUZ[t] - parameter.UZL, 0)
1791
1792        # update upper groundwater box
1793        SUZ[t] -= Q0
1794
1795        # runoff from the middle part of upper groundwater box
1796        Q1 = parameter.K1 * SUZ[t]
1797
1798        # update upper groundwater box
1799        SUZ[t] -= Q1
1800
1801        # calculate lower groundwater box
1802        SLZ[t] = SLZ[t - 1] + perc
1803
1804        # runoff from lower groundwater box
1805        Q2 = parameter.K2 * SLZ[t]
1806
1807        # update lower groundwater box
1808        SLZ[t] -= Q2
1809
1810        # Total runoff calculation
1811        Qsim[t] = Q0 + Q1 + Q2
1812
1813    # 6. Scale effect accounting
1814    # delay and smoothing simulated hydrograph
1815    # (Beck et al.,2016) used triangular transformation based on moving window
1816    # here are my method with simple forward filter based on Butterworth filter design
1817    # calculate Numerator (b) and denominator (a) polynomials of the IIR filter
1818    parMAXBAS = int(parameter.MAXBAS)
1819    b, a = ss.butter(parMAXBAS, 1 / parMAXBAS)
1820    # implement forward filter
1821    Qsim_smoothed = ss.lfilter(b, a, Qsim)
1822    # control smoothed runoff
1823    Qsim_smoothed = np.where(Qsim_smoothed > 0, Qsim_smoothed, 0)
1824
1825    Qsim = Qsim_smoothed
1826    hbv_results = pd.DataFrame(
1827        {
1828            "HBV_temp": Temp,
1829            "HBV_prec": Prec,
1830            "HBV_rain": RAIN,
1831            "HBV_snow": SNOW,
1832            "HBV_pe": Evap,
1833            "HBV_snowpack": SNOWPACK,
1834            "HBV_soil_moisture": SM,
1835            "HBV_AET": ETact,
1836            "HBV_refreezing": refreezing_off_glacier,
1837            "HBV_upper_gw": SUZ,
1838            "HBV_lower_gw": SLZ,
1839            "HBV_melt_off_glacier": off_glac,
1840            "Q_HBV": Qsim,
1841        },
1842        index=input_df_hbv[parameter.sim_start : parameter.sim_end].index,
1843    )
1844    print("Finished HBV routine")
1845    return hbv_results
1846
1847
1848def create_statistics(output_MATILDA):
1849    """
1850    Generates descriptive statistics for a given MATILDA output DataFrame.
1851
1852    Parameters
1853    ----------
1854    output_MATILDA : pandas.DataFrame
1855        Input DataFrame containing MATILDA model output variables.
1856
1857    Returns
1858    -------
1859    pandas.DataFrame
1860        A DataFrame containing descriptive statistics (e.g., mean, standard deviation, min, max)
1861        for each column in `output_MATILDA`, along with the sum of all columns appended as an additional row.
1862
1863    Notes
1864    -----
1865    1. The sum row is labeled as "sum" and included at the bottom of the statistics DataFrame.
1866    2. All values are rounded to three decimal places for consistency.
1867    """
1868
1869    stats = output_MATILDA.describe()
1870    column_sums = pd.DataFrame(
1871        output_MATILDA.sum()
1872    )  # Renamed from `sum` to `column_sums`
1873    column_sums.columns = ["sum"]
1874    column_sums = column_sums.transpose()
1875    stats = pd.concat([stats, column_sums])
1876    stats = stats.round(3)
1877    return stats
1878
1879
1880def matilda_submodules(
1881    df_preproc,
1882    parameter,
1883    obs=None,
1884    glacier_profile=None,
1885    elev_rescaling=False,
1886    drop_surplus=False,
1887):
1888    """
1889    Executes the main MATILDA simulation, which integrates data preprocessing, Degree Day Model (DDM), HBV hydrological model,
1890    and optional glacier elevation rescaling to produce comprehensive runoff and hydrological outputs.
1891
1892    Parameters
1893    ----------
1894    df_preproc : pandas.DataFrame
1895        Preprocessed input dataset containing climate variables such as temperature, precipitation, snow, and rain.
1896    parameter : pandas.Series
1897        Series of MATILDA parameters including:
1898            - Simulation settings (`sim_start`, `sim_end`, `set_up_start`, `set_up_end`, `freq`, `freq_long`).
1899            - Glacier parameters (`area_glac`, `area_cat`, `ele_glac`, `ele_cat`, `warn`).
1900            - HBV and DDM model parameters.
1901    obs : pandas.DataFrame, optional
1902        Observed runoff data for model evaluation. Defaults to None.
1903    glacier_profile : pandas.DataFrame, optional
1904        Initial glacier profile with columns such as `Area`, `WE` (water equivalent), and `Elevation`. Required if `elev_rescaling=True`.
1905    elev_rescaling : bool, optional
1906        If True, enables glacier elevation rescaling based on the deltaH scaling routine. Defaults to False.
1907    drop_surplus : bool, optional
1908        If True, drops runs where the cumulative surface mass balance (SMB) is positive. Defaults to False.
1909
1910    Returns
1911    -------
1912    list
1913        A list containing the following elements:
1914            - `output_MATILDA_compact` (pandas.DataFrame): Compact output with key variables for quick assessment.
1915            - `output_MATILDA` (pandas.DataFrame): Full simulation results including all variables.
1916            - `kge` (str or float): Kling-Gupta Efficiency coefficient for model performance evaluation.
1917            - `stats` (pandas.DataFrame): Statistical summary of the simulation results.
1918            - `lookup_table` (str or pandas.DataFrame): Lookup table for glacier area changes (if applicable).
1919            - `glacier_change` (str or pandas.DataFrame): Time series of glacier changes (if applicable).
1920
1921    Notes
1922    -----
1923    1. If `elev_rescaling=True` and `glacier_profile` is provided, glacier elevation and area are dynamically updated annually.
1924    2. When glacier elevation scaling is turned off, average glacier elevation is treated as constant, which may introduce biases for longer simulations.
1925    3. Observed runoff (`obs`) is required for model efficiency metrics such as KGE, NSE, RMSE, and MARE.
1926    4. The function calculates and outputs both compact and detailed results for downstream analyses.
1927
1928    Warnings
1929    --------
1930    - If no glacier profile is provided while `elev_rescaling=True`, an error is raised.
1931    - Glacier melt calculations are skipped if the glacier area is zero (`area_glac = 0`).
1932    - Model efficiency metrics are not calculated if observed data (`obs`) is not provided.
1933    """
1934
1935    # Filter warnings:
1936    if not parameter.warn:
1937        warnings.filterwarnings(action="ignore")
1938
1939    print("---")
1940    print("Initiating MATILDA simulation")
1941
1942    # Rescale glacier elevation or not?
1943    if elev_rescaling:
1944        # Execute glacier-rescaling module
1945        if parameter.area_glac > 0:
1946            if glacier_profile is not None:
1947                lookup_table = create_lookup_table(glacier_profile, parameter)
1948                output_DDM, glacier_change, input_df_catchment = updated_glacier_melt(
1949                    df_preproc,
1950                    lookup_table,
1951                    glacier_profile,
1952                    parameter,
1953                    drop_surplus=drop_surplus,
1954                )
1955            else:
1956                raise ValueError(
1957                    "ERROR: No glacier profile passed for glacier elevation rescaling! Provide a glacier profile or"
1958                    " set elev_rescaling=False"
1959                )
1960        else:
1961            lookup_table = str("No lookup table generated")
1962            glacier_change = str("No glacier changes calculated")
1963
1964    else:
1965        print(
1966            "WARNING: Glacier elevation scaling is turned off. The average glacier elevation is treated as constant. "
1967            "This might cause a significant bias in glacier melt on larger time scales! Set elev_rescaling=True "
1968            "to annually rescale glacier elevations."
1969        )
1970        # Scale input data to fit catchments elevations
1971        if parameter.ele_dat is not None:
1972            input_df_glacier, input_df_catchment = input_scaling(df_preproc, parameter)
1973        else:
1974            input_df_glacier = df_preproc.copy()
1975            input_df_catchment = df_preproc.copy()
1976
1977        input_df_glacier = input_df_glacier[parameter.sim_start : parameter.sim_end]
1978
1979        # Execute DDM module
1980        if parameter.area_glac > 0:
1981            degreedays_ds = calculate_PDD(input_df_glacier)
1982            output_DDM = calculate_glaciermelt(degreedays_ds, parameter)
1983
1984        # Execute glacier re-scaling module
1985        if parameter.area_glac > 0:
1986            if glacier_profile is not None:
1987                lookup_table = create_lookup_table(glacier_profile, parameter)
1988                output_DDM, glacier_change = glacier_area_change(
1989                    output_DDM, lookup_table, glacier_profile, parameter
1990                )
1991            else:
1992                # scaling DDM output to fraction of catchment area
1993                for col in output_DDM.columns.drop(["DDM_smb", "pdd"]):
1994                    output_DDM[col + "_scaled"] = output_DDM[col] * (
1995                        parameter.area_glac / parameter.area_cat
1996                    )
1997
1998                lookup_table = str("No lookup table generated")
1999                glacier_change = str("No glacier changes calculated")
2000        else:
2001            lookup_table = str("No lookup table generated")
2002            glacier_change = str("No glacier changes calculated")
2003
2004    # Execute HBV module:
2005    if glacier_profile is not None:
2006        output_HBV = hbv_simulation(
2007            input_df_catchment, parameter, glacier_area=glacier_change
2008        )
2009    else:
2010        output_HBV = hbv_simulation(input_df_catchment, parameter)
2011    output_HBV = output_HBV[parameter.sim_start : parameter.sim_end]
2012
2013    # Output postprocessing
2014    if parameter.area_glac > 0:
2015        output_MATILDA = pd.concat([output_HBV, output_DDM], axis=1)
2016    else:
2017        output_MATILDA = output_HBV.copy()
2018
2019    if obs is not None:
2020        output_MATILDA = pd.concat([output_MATILDA, obs], axis=1)
2021
2022    if parameter.area_glac > 0:
2023        if glacier_profile is not None:
2024            output_MATILDA["Q_Total"] = (
2025                output_MATILDA["Q_HBV"] + output_MATILDA["Q_DDM_updated_scaled"]
2026            )
2027            output_MATILDA["Prec_total"] = (
2028                output_MATILDA["DDM_rain_updated_scaled"]
2029                + output_MATILDA["DDM_snow_updated_scaled"]
2030                + output_MATILDA["HBV_rain"]
2031                + output_MATILDA["HBV_snow"]
2032            )
2033            output_MATILDA["Melt_total"] = (
2034                output_MATILDA["DDM_total_melt_updated_scaled"]
2035                + output_MATILDA["HBV_melt_off_glacier"]
2036            )
2037        else:
2038            output_MATILDA["Q_Total"] = (
2039                output_MATILDA["Q_HBV"] + output_MATILDA["Q_DDM_scaled"]
2040            )
2041            output_MATILDA["Prec_total"] = (
2042                output_MATILDA["DDM_rain_scaled"]
2043                + output_MATILDA["DDM_snow_scaled"]
2044                + output_MATILDA["HBV_rain"]
2045                + output_MATILDA["HBV_snow"]
2046            )
2047            output_MATILDA["Melt_total"] = (
2048                output_MATILDA["DDM_total_melt_scaled"]
2049                + output_MATILDA["HBV_melt_off_glacier"]
2050            )
2051    else:
2052        output_MATILDA["Q_Total"] = output_MATILDA["Q_HBV"]
2053
2054    output_MATILDA = output_MATILDA[parameter.sim_start : parameter.sim_end]
2055
2056    if "smb_flag" in output_MATILDA.columns:
2057        output_MATILDA["Q_Total"] = 0.01
2058
2059    # Add compact output
2060    if parameter.area_glac > 0:
2061        if glacier_profile is not None:
2062            output_MATILDA_compact = pd.DataFrame(
2063                {
2064                    "avg_temp_catchment": output_MATILDA["HBV_temp"],
2065                    "avg_temp_glaciers": output_MATILDA["DDM_temp"],
2066                    "evap_off_glaciers": output_MATILDA["HBV_pe"],
2067                    "prec_off_glaciers": output_MATILDA["HBV_prec"],
2068                    "prec_on_glaciers": output_MATILDA["DDM_prec_updated_scaled"],
2069                    "rain_off_glaciers": output_MATILDA["HBV_rain"],
2070                    "snow_off_glaciers": output_MATILDA["HBV_snow"],
2071                    "rain_on_glaciers": output_MATILDA["DDM_rain_updated_scaled"],
2072                    "snow_on_glaciers": output_MATILDA["DDM_snow_updated_scaled"],
2073                    "snowpack_off_glaciers": output_MATILDA["HBV_snowpack"],
2074                    "soil_moisture": output_MATILDA["HBV_soil_moisture"],
2075                    "upper_groundwater": output_MATILDA["HBV_upper_gw"],
2076                    "lower_groundwater": output_MATILDA["HBV_lower_gw"],
2077                    "melt_off_glaciers": output_MATILDA["HBV_melt_off_glacier"],
2078                    "melt_on_glaciers": output_MATILDA["DDM_total_melt_updated_scaled"],
2079                    "ice_melt_on_glaciers": output_MATILDA[
2080                        "DDM_ice_melt_updated_scaled"
2081                    ],
2082                    "snow_melt_on_glaciers": output_MATILDA[
2083                        "DDM_snow_melt_updated_scaled"
2084                    ],
2085                    "refreezing_glacier": output_MATILDA[
2086                        "DDM_refreezing_updated_scaled"
2087                    ],
2088                    "total_refreezing": output_MATILDA["DDM_refreezing_updated_scaled"]
2089                    + output_MATILDA["HBV_refreezing"],
2090                    "SMB": output_MATILDA["DDM_smb"],
2091                    "actual_evaporation": output_MATILDA["HBV_AET"],
2092                    "total_precipitation": output_MATILDA["Prec_total"],
2093                    "total_melt": output_MATILDA["Melt_total"],
2094                    "runoff_without_glaciers": output_MATILDA["Q_HBV"],
2095                    "runoff_from_glaciers": output_MATILDA["Q_DDM_updated_scaled"],
2096                    "runoff_ratio": np.where(
2097                        output_MATILDA["Prec_total"] == 0,
2098                        0,
2099                        output_MATILDA["Q_Total"] / output_MATILDA["Prec_total"],
2100                    ),
2101                    "total_runoff": output_MATILDA["Q_Total"],
2102                },
2103                index=output_MATILDA.index,
2104            )
2105            if obs is not None:
2106                output_MATILDA_compact["observed_runoff"] = output_MATILDA["Qobs"]
2107        else:
2108            output_MATILDA_compact = pd.DataFrame(
2109                {
2110                    "avg_temp_catchment": output_MATILDA["HBV_temp"],
2111                    "avg_temp_glaciers": output_MATILDA["DDM_temp"],
2112                    "evap_off_glaciers": output_MATILDA["HBV_pe"],
2113                    "prec_off_glaciers": output_MATILDA["HBV_prec"],
2114                    "prec_on_glaciers": output_MATILDA["DDM_prec_scaled"],
2115                    "rain_off_glaciers": output_MATILDA["HBV_rain"],
2116                    "snow_off_glaciers": output_MATILDA["HBV_snow"],
2117                    "rain_on_glaciers": output_MATILDA["DDM_rain_scaled"],
2118                    "snow_on_glaciers": output_MATILDA["DDM_snow_scaled"],
2119                    "snowpack_off_glaciers": output_MATILDA["HBV_snowpack"],
2120                    "soil_moisture": output_MATILDA["HBV_soil_moisture"],
2121                    "upper_groundwater": output_MATILDA["HBV_upper_gw"],
2122                    "lower_groundwater": output_MATILDA["HBV_lower_gw"],
2123                    "melt_off_glaciers": output_MATILDA["HBV_melt_off_glacier"],
2124                    "melt_on_glaciers": output_MATILDA["DDM_total_melt_scaled"],
2125                    "ice_melt_on_glaciers": output_MATILDA["DDM_ice_melt_scaled"],
2126                    "snow_melt_on_glaciers": output_MATILDA["DDM_snow_melt_scaled"],
2127                    "refreezing_glacier": output_MATILDA["DDM_refreezing_scaled"],
2128                    "total_refreezing": output_MATILDA["DDM_refreezing_scaled"]
2129                    + output_MATILDA["HBV_refreezing"],
2130                    "SMB": output_MATILDA["DDM_smb"],
2131                    "actual_evaporation": output_MATILDA["HBV_AET"],
2132                    "total_precipitation": output_MATILDA["Prec_total"],
2133                    "total_melt": output_MATILDA["Melt_total"],
2134                    "runoff_without_glaciers": output_MATILDA["Q_HBV"],
2135                    "runoff_from_glaciers": output_MATILDA["Q_DDM_scaled"],
2136                    "runoff_ratio": np.where(
2137                        output_MATILDA["Prec_total"] == 0,
2138                        0,
2139                        output_MATILDA["Q_Total"] / output_MATILDA["Prec_total"],
2140                    ),
2141                    "total_runoff": output_MATILDA["Q_Total"],
2142                },
2143                index=output_MATILDA.index,
2144            )
2145            if obs is not None:
2146                output_MATILDA_compact["observed_runoff"] = output_MATILDA["Qobs"]
2147
2148    else:
2149        output_MATILDA_compact = pd.DataFrame(
2150            {
2151                "avg_temp_catchment": output_MATILDA["HBV_temp"],
2152                "prec": output_MATILDA["HBV_prec"],
2153                "rain": output_MATILDA["HBV_rain"],
2154                "snow": output_MATILDA["HBV_snow"],
2155                "snowpack": output_MATILDA["HBV_snowpack"],
2156                "soil_moisture": output_MATILDA["HBV_soil_moisture"],
2157                "upper_groundwater": output_MATILDA["HBV_upper_gw"],
2158                "lower_groundwater": output_MATILDA["HBV_lower_gw"],
2159                "snow_melt": output_MATILDA["HBV_melt_off_glacier"],
2160                "total_refreezing": output_MATILDA["HBV_refreezing"],
2161                "actual_evaporation": output_MATILDA["HBV_AET"],
2162                "runoff_ratio": np.where(
2163                    output_MATILDA["HBV_prec"] == 0,
2164                    0,
2165                    output_MATILDA["Q_HBV"] / output_MATILDA["HBV_prec"],
2166                ),
2167                "runoff": output_MATILDA["Q_HBV"],
2168            },
2169            index=output_MATILDA.index,
2170        )
2171        if obs is not None:
2172            output_MATILDA_compact["observed_runoff"] = output_MATILDA["Qobs"]
2173
2174        # if obs is not None:
2175    #     output_MATILDA.loc[output_MATILDA.isnull().any(axis=1), :] = np.nan
2176
2177    # Model efficiency coefficients
2178    if obs is not None and "smb_flag" not in output_MATILDA.columns:
2179        sim = output_MATILDA["Q_Total"]
2180        target = output_MATILDA["Qobs"]
2181        # Crop both timeseries to same periods without NAs
2182        sim_new = pd.DataFrame()
2183        sim_new["mod"] = pd.DataFrame(sim)
2184        sim_new["obs"] = target
2185        clean = sim_new.dropna()
2186        sim = clean["mod"]
2187        target = clean["obs"]
2188
2189        if parameter.freq == "D":
2190            nash_sut = he.nse(sim, target, remove_zero=True)
2191            kge = he.kge_2012(sim, target, remove_zero=True)
2192            rmse = he.rmse(sim, target)
2193            mare = hydroeval.evaluator(hydroeval.mare, sim, target)
2194            print("*-------------------*")
2195            print("KGE coefficient: " + str(round(float(kge), 2)))
2196            print("NSE coefficient: " + str(round(nash_sut, 2)))
2197            print("RMSE: " + str(round(float(rmse), 2)))
2198            print("MARE coefficient: " + str(round(float(mare), 2)))
2199            print("*-------------------*")
2200        else:
2201            sim = sim.resample(parameter.freq).agg(pd.Series.sum, min_count=1)
2202            target = target.resample(parameter.freq).agg(pd.Series.sum, min_count=1)
2203            nash_sut = he.nse(sim, target, remove_zero=True)
2204            kge = he.kge_2012(sim, target, remove_zero=True)
2205            rmse = he.rmse(sim, target)
2206            mare = hydroeval.evaluator(hydroeval.mare, sim, target)
2207            print("*-------------------*")
2208            print(
2209                "** Model efficiency based on " + parameter.freq_long + " aggregates **"
2210            )
2211            print("KGE coefficient: " + str(round(float(kge), 2)))
2212            print("NSE coefficient: " + str(round(nash_sut, 2)))
2213            print("RMSE: " + str(round(float(rmse), 2)))
2214            print("MARE coefficient: " + str(round(float(mare), 2)))
2215            print("*-------------------*")
2216    else:
2217        kge = str(
2218            "No observations available to calculate model efficiency coefficients."
2219        )
2220
2221    # if obs is not None:
2222    dat_stats = output_MATILDA_compact.copy()
2223    dat_stats.loc[dat_stats.isnull().any(axis=1), :] = np.nan
2224    stats = create_statistics(dat_stats)
2225
2226    print(stats)
2227    print("End of the MATILDA simulation")
2228    print("---")
2229    output_MATILDA = output_MATILDA.round(3)
2230    output_all = [
2231        output_MATILDA_compact,
2232        output_MATILDA,
2233        kge,
2234        stats,
2235        lookup_table,
2236        glacier_change,
2237    ]
2238
2239    return output_all
