2241
2242def matilda_plots(output_MATILDA, parameter, plot_type="print"):
2243    """
2244    Generates visualizations for MATILDA simulation results, including meteorological inputs, runoff outputs, and HBV reservoir variables.
2245    Supports multiple plotting styles (static, interactive, and combined).
2246
2247    Parameters
2248    ----------
2249    output_MATILDA : list
2250        MATILDA simulation output containing the following elements:
2251            - Compact output (pandas.DataFrame): Key simulation variables (e.g., runoff, precipitation, temperature).
2252            - Full simulation results (pandas.DataFrame).
2253            - Model efficiency metric (e.g., Kling-Gupta Efficiency coefficient).
2254            - Statistics (pandas.DataFrame).
2255            - Glacier lookup table (if applicable).
2256            - Glacier change data (if applicable).
2257    parameter : pandas.Series
2258        Series of MATILDA parameters, including:
2259            - `freq`: Frequency for resampling (e.g., "D" for daily, "M" for monthly, "Y" for yearly).
2260            - `freq_long`: Long-form frequency description (e.g., "Daily", "Monthly").
2261            - `sim_start`: Start date of the simulation period (YYYY-MM-DD).
2262            - `sim_end`: End date of the simulation period (YYYY-MM-DD).
2263    plot_type : str, optional
2264        Specifies the type of plots to generate:
2265            - `"print"`: Static plots using Matplotlib.
2266            - `"interactive"`: Interactive plots using Plotly.
2267            - `"all"`: Both static and interactive plots.
2268            Defaults to `"print"`.
2269
2270    Returns
2271    -------
2272    list
2273        The updated `output_MATILDA` list with added visualizations. The plots are appended as follows:
2274            - Static Matplotlib plots: `[fig1, fig2, fig3]` for meteorological inputs, runoff, and HBV reservoirs, respectively.
2275            - Interactive Plotly plots: `[fig1, fig2]` for full results and annual mean results, respectively.
2276
2277    Notes
2278    -----
2279    1. **Static Plots**:
2280        - Plots meteorological inputs (temperature, precipitation, evaporation).
2281        - Visualizes runoff contributions and comparisons with observed data (if available).
2282        - Displays HBV reservoir outputs (soil moisture, snowpack, groundwater).
2283    2. **Interactive Plots**:
2284        - Provides detailed and zoomable visualizations for meteorological inputs, runoff, and contributions using Plotly.
2285        - Includes annotations for model efficiency metrics like KGE.
2286    3. Data is resampled to the specified frequency (`freq`) for consistent visualization across time steps.
2287    4. Observed runoff data (`observed_runoff`) is included if available in the input.
2288
2289    Warnings
2290    --------
2291    - Ensure that `output_MATILDA` contains valid simulation results before calling this function.
2292    - Interactive plots require Plotly; ensure it is installed for `"interactive"` or `"all"` options.
2293    - Large datasets may cause performance issues with interactive plotting.
2294    """
2295
2296    # resampling the output to the specified frequency
2297    def plot_data(output_MATILDA, parameter):
2298        if "observed_runoff" in output_MATILDA[0].columns:
2299            # obs = output_MATILDA[1]["Qobs"].resample(parameter.freq).agg(pd.DataFrame.sum, skipna=False)
2300            obs = (
2301                output_MATILDA[0]["observed_runoff"]
2302                .resample(parameter.freq)
2303                .agg(pd.Series.sum, min_count=1)
2304            )
2305        if "Q_DDM" in output_MATILDA[1].columns:
2306            plot_data = (
2307                output_MATILDA[0]
2308                .resample(parameter.freq)
2309                .agg(
2310                    {
2311                        "avg_temp_catchment": "mean",
2312                        "rain_off_glaciers": "sum",
2313                        "rain_on_glaciers": "sum",
2314                        "prec_off_glaciers": "sum",
2315                        "prec_on_glaciers": "sum",
2316                        "total_precipitation": "sum",
2317                        "evap_off_glaciers": "sum",
2318                        "melt_off_glaciers": "sum",
2319                        "melt_on_glaciers": "sum",
2320                        "ice_melt_on_glaciers": "sum",
2321                        "snow_melt_on_glaciers": "sum",
2322                        "runoff_without_glaciers": "sum",
2323                        "runoff_from_glaciers": "sum",
2324                        "total_runoff": "sum",
2325                        "actual_evaporation": "sum",
2326                        "snowpack_off_glaciers": "mean",
2327                        "refreezing_glacier": "sum",
2328                        "total_refreezing": "sum",
2329                        "soil_moisture": "mean",
2330                        "upper_groundwater": "mean",
2331                        "lower_groundwater": "mean",
2332                    },
2333                    skipna=False,
2334                )
2335            )
2336        else:
2337            plot_data = (
2338                output_MATILDA[0]
2339                .resample(parameter.freq)
2340                .agg(
2341                    {
2342                        "avg_temp_catchment": "mean",
2343                        "rain_off_glaciers": "sum",
2344                        "rain_on_glaciers": "sum",
2345                        "prec_off_glaciers": "sum",
2346                        "total_precipitation": "sum",
2347                        "evap_off_glaciers": "sum",
2348                        "runoff_without_glaciers": "sum",
2349                        "total_runoff": "sum",
2350                        "actual_evaporation": "sum",
2351                        "snowpack_off_glaciers": "mean",
2352                        "total_refreezing": "sum",
2353                        "soil_moisture": "mean",
2354                        "upper_groundwater": "mean",
2355                        "lower_groundwater": "mean",
2356                    },
2357                    skipna=False,
2358                )
2359            )
2360        if "observed_runoff" in output_MATILDA[0].columns:
2361            plot_data["observed_runoff"] = obs
2362
2363        plot_annual_data = output_MATILDA[0].copy()
2364        plot_annual_data["month"] = plot_annual_data.index.month
2365        plot_annual_data["day"] = plot_annual_data.index.day
2366        plot_annual_data = plot_annual_data.groupby(["month", "day"]).mean()
2367        plot_annual_data["date"] = pd.date_range(
2368            parameter.sim_start, freq="D", periods=len(plot_annual_data)
2369        ).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
2370        plot_annual_data = plot_annual_data.set_index(plot_annual_data["date"])
2371        plot_annual_data.index = pd.to_datetime(plot_annual_data.index)
2372        plot_annual_data["plot"] = 0
2373        if parameter.freq == "Y":
2374            plot_annual_data = plot_annual_data.resample("M").agg(
2375                pd.Series.sum, min_count=1
2376            )
2377        else:
2378            plot_annual_data = plot_annual_data.resample(parameter.freq).agg(
2379                pd.Series.sum, min_count=1
2380            )
2381
2382        return plot_data, plot_annual_data

2384    # Plot the meteorological variables
2385    def plot_meteo(plot_data, parameter):
2386        fig, (ax1, ax2, ax3) = plt.subplots(

2388        )

2396            ax2.fill_between(
2397                x_vals,
2398                plot_data["total_precipitation"],
2399                plot_data["prec_off_glaciers"],
2400                color="#77bbff",

2472        # AX1 (upper left): simulation vs observed for defined period

2506
2507        if isinstance(output_MATILDA[2], float):

2516            )

2532            #          linewidth=0.75, alpha=0.75)

2580        )
2581
2582        ax3.stackplot(

2586            labels=["Actual Evaporation", "Refreezing"],
2587            colors=["#cce4ee", "#bababa"],
2588        )
2589
2590        ax3.legend(loc="upper left", ncol=5, prop={"size": 6}, bbox_to_anchor=(0.01, 1))
2591        ax3.set_ylabel("[mm]")
2592
2593        # AX4:

2597        )
2598        snow_melt = (

2600            + plot_annual_data["snow_melt_on_glaciers"]
2601        )
2602        glacier_melt = plot_annual_data["ice_melt_on_glaciers"]
2603
2604        ax4.axhline(0, color="k", linewidth=0.5)
2605        ax4.stackplot(
2606            x_vals,
2607            rain,
2608            snow_melt,
2609            glacier_melt,
2610            labels=["Rain", "Snow Melt", "Glacier Melt"],
2611            colors=["#6c1e58", "#a6135a", "#d72f41"],
2612        )
2613
2614        ax4.stackplot(
2615            x_vals,
2616            plot_annual_data["actual_evaporation"] * -1,
2617            plot_annual_data["total_refreezing"] * -1,
2618            labels=["Actual Evaporation", "Refreezing"],
2619            colors=["#cce4ee", "#bababa"],
2620        )
2621
2622        if parameter.freq == "Y" or parameter.freq == "M":
2623            # formatting for 'monthly' looks strange, therefore default ticks (major+minor) will be overwritten
2624            ax4.set_xticks(x_vals[::], minor=True)  # minor tick for each month
2625            ax4.set_xticks(x_vals[::3])  # major tick every 3rd month
2626            ax4.set_xticklabels(plot_annual_data.index.strftime("%b")[::3])
2627        else:
2628            ax4.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.MonthLocator(interval=3))
2629            ax4.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter("%b"))
2630        ax4.set_xlim(x_vals[0], x_vals[-1])
2631
2632        # sync y-axis limits
2633        y_min1, y_max1 = ax1.dataLim.intervaly
2634        y_min3, y_max3 = ax3.dataLim.intervaly
2635        y_min = min(y_min1, y_min3)
2636        y_max = max(y_max1, y_max3)
2637        y_ext = (
2638            abs(y_min) + abs(y_max)
2639        ) / ax1.bbox.height  # normalize y-axis steps in pixels
2640        ax1.set_ylim(0, y_max + y_ext * 30)  # extent 30px pos (legend space)
2641        ax3.set_ylim(
2642            y_min - y_ext * 10, y_max + y_ext * 30
2643        )  # extent 10px neg and 30px pos (legend space)
2644
2645        if str(plot_data.index.values[1])[:4] == str(plot_data.index.values[-1])[:4]:
2646            ax1.set_title(
2647                parameter.freq_long
2648                + " MATILDA Simulation "
2649                + "("
2650                + str(plot_data.index.values[-1])[:4]
2651                + ")"
2652            )
2653        else:
2654            ax1.set_title(
2655                parameter.freq_long
2656                + " MATILDA Simulation "
2657                + "("
2658                + str(plot_data.index.values[0])[:4]
2659                + "-"
2660                + str(plot_data.index.values[-1])[:4]
2661                + ")"
2662            )
2663        return fig

2665    # Plot the HBV output variables
2666    def plot_hbv(plot_data, parameter):
2667        fig, (ax1, ax2, ax3, ax4, ax5) = plt.subplots(
2668            5, sharex=True, figsize=(8, 5.2), dpi=150, constrained_layout=True
2669        )
2670
2671        x_vals = plot_data.index.to_pydatetime()
2672        ax1.plot(x_vals, plot_data["actual_evaporation"], color="#009988")
2673        ax2.plot(x_vals, plot_data["soil_moisture"], color="#CC3311")

3132def matilda_save_output(output_MATILDA, parameter, output_path, plot_type="print"):
3133    """
3134    Saves MATILDA simulation outputs, statistics, parameters, glacier area changes, and plots to the local disk.
3135
3136    Parameters
3137    ----------
3138    output_MATILDA : list
3139        List containing the outputs from the MATILDA simulation. Includes:
3140            - Full model output (pandas.DataFrame).
3141            - Model statistics (pandas.DataFrame).
3142            - Model parameters (pandas.Series).
3143            - Glacier area data (optional, pandas.DataFrame).
3144            - Plots (Matplotlib or Plotly objects, depending on the plot type).
3145    parameter : pandas.Series
3146        Series containing the simulation parameters, including:
3147            - `sim_start`: Start date of the simulation period (YYYY-MM-DD).
3148            - `sim_end`: End date of the simulation period (YYYY-MM-DD).
3149    output_path : str
3150        Directory path where the output files will be saved. A subfolder with the simulation date and time will be created.
3151    plot_type : str, optional
3152        Specifies the type of plots to save:
3153            - `"print"`: Saves Matplotlib plots as PNG files.
3154            - `"interactive"`: Saves Plotly plots as HTML files.
3155            - `"all"`: Saves both Matplotlib and Plotly plots in their respective formats.
3156        Defaults to `"print"`.
3157
3158    Returns
3159    -------
3160    None
3161        Saves the outputs and plots to the specified directory.
3162
3163    Notes
3164    -----
3165    1. A subdirectory is created under `output_path` with a timestamped name for organizing the outputs.
3166    2. The outputs saved include:
3167        - Full simulation results as CSV (`model_output_<date_range>.csv`).
3168        - Statistics as CSV (`model_stats_<date_range>.csv`).
3169        - Parameters as CSV (`model_parameter.csv`).
3170        - Glacier area changes as CSV (`glacier_area_<date_range>.csv`) if applicable.
3171    3. Plots are saved in the specified format (`PNG` or `HTML`).
3172    4. The function automatically handles the appending of date ranges and timestamps to filenames.
3173
3174    Warnings
3175    --------
3176    - Ensure the specified `output_path` exists and has write permissions.
3177    - When using `"interactive"` or `"all"`, ensure Plotly is installed for saving HTML plots.
3178
3179    Examples
3180    --------
3181    Save MATILDA outputs and plots (Matplotlib only):
3182    >>> matilda_save_output(output_MATILDA, parameter, "/path/to/output", plot_type="print")
3183
3184    Save MATILDA outputs and interactive plots (Plotly):
3185    >>> matilda_save_output(output_MATILDA, parameter, "/path/to/output", plot_type="interactive")
3186
3187    Save MATILDA outputs with both static and interactive plots:
3188    >>> matilda_save_output(output_MATILDA, parameter, "/path/to/output", plot_type="all")
3189    """
3190
3191    if output_path[-1] == "/":
3192        output_path = (
3193            output_path
3194            + parameter.sim_start[:4]
3195            + "_"
3196            + parameter.sim_end[:4]
3197            + "_"
3198            + datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")
3199            + "/"
3200        )
3201    else:
3202        output_path = (
3203            output_path
3204            + "/"
3205            + parameter.sim_start[:4]
3206            + "_"
3207            + parameter.sim_end[:4]
3208            + "_"
3209            + datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")
3210            + "/"
3211        )
3212    os.mkdir(output_path)  # creating the folder to save the plots
3213
3214    # construct date range for chart titles
3215    range_from = str(output_MATILDA[1].index.values[1])[:4]
3216    range_to = str(output_MATILDA[1].index.values[-1])[:4]
3217    if range_from == range_to:
3218        date_range = range_from
3219    else:
3220        date_range = range_from + "-" + range_to
3221
3222    print("Saving the MATILDA output to disc")
3223    output_MATILDA[1].to_csv(output_path + "model_output_" + date_range + ".csv")
3224    output_MATILDA[3].to_csv(output_path + "model_stats_" + date_range + ".csv")
3225    parameter.to_csv(output_path + "model_parameter.csv")
3226
3227    if isinstance(output_MATILDA[5], pd.DataFrame):
3228        output_MATILDA[5].to_csv(output_path + "glacier_area_" + date_range + ".csv")
3229
3230    if plot_type == "print":
3231        # save plots from matplotlib as .png files
3232        output_MATILDA[6].savefig(
3233            output_path + "meteorological_data_" + date_range + ".png",
3234            bbox_inches="tight",
3235            dpi=output_MATILDA[6].dpi,
3236        )
3237        output_MATILDA[7].savefig(
3238            output_path + "model_runoff_" + date_range + ".png",
3239            dpi=output_MATILDA[7].dpi,
3240        )
3241        output_MATILDA[8].savefig(
3242            output_path + "HBV_output_" + date_range + ".png", dpi=output_MATILDA[8].dpi
3243        )
3244
3245    elif plot_type == "interactive":
3246        # save plots from plotly as .html file
3247        output_MATILDA[6].write_html(
3248            output_path + "matilda_plots_" + date_range + ".html"
3249        )
3250        output_MATILDA[7].write_html(
3251            output_path + "matilda_plots_annual_" + date_range + ".html"
3252        )
3253
3254    elif plot_type == "all":
3255        # save plots from matplotlib and plotly as .png files
3256        output_MATILDA[6].savefig(
3257            output_path + "meteorological_data_" + date_range + ".png",
3258            bbox_inches="tight",
3259            dpi=output_MATILDA[6].dpi,
3260        )
3261        output_MATILDA[7].savefig(
3262            output_path + "model_runoff_" + date_range + ".png",
3263            dpi=output_MATILDA[7].dpi,
3264        )
3265        output_MATILDA[8].savefig(
3266            output_path + "HBV_output_" + date_range + ".png", dpi=output_MATILDA[8].dpi
3267        )
3268
3269        # save plots from plotly as .html file
3270        output_MATILDA[9].write_html(
3271            output_path + "matilda_plots_" + date_range + ".html"
3272        )
3273        output_MATILDA[10].write_html(
3274            output_path + "matilda_plots_annual_" + date_range + ".html"
3275        )
3276
3277    print("---")

3280def matilda_simulation(
3281    input_df,
3282    obs=None,
3283    glacier_profile=None,
3284    output=None,
3285    warn=False,
3286    set_up_start=None,
3287    set_up_end=None,
3288    sim_start=None,
3289    sim_end=None,
3290    freq="D",
3291    lat=None,
3292    area_cat=None,
3293    area_glac=None,
3294    ele_dat=None,
3295    ele_glac=None,
3296    ele_cat=None,
3297    plots=True,
3298    plot_type="print",
3299    science_plot=True,
3300    elev_rescaling=False,
3301    drop_surplus=False,
3302    **matilda_param,
3303):
3304    """
3305    Run the complete MATILDA simulation framework, including preprocessing, simulation, and optional output saving.
3306
3307    This function integrates data preprocessing, hydrological and glacial simulations, and optional output handling
3308    using the MATILDA framework. It can perform simulations with default or user-defined parameters, handle optional
3309    glacier rescaling, and generate visualizations and model statistics.
3310
3311    Parameters
3312    ----------
3313    input_df : pandas.DataFrame
3314        Input meteorological data for the simulation. Must include timestamp and relevant fields (e.g., temperature, precipitation).
3315    obs : pandas.DataFrame, optional
3316        Observed runoff data for model calibration or comparison. If provided, it will be included in outputs.
3317    glacier_profile : pandas.DataFrame, optional
3318        Glacier profile data for elevation-based glacier rescaling routines. If not provided, glacier rescaling is disabled.
3319    output : str, optional
3320        Directory path to save outputs (CSV files, statistics, plots). If not specified, outputs are not saved.
3321    warn : bool, optional
3322        Whether to show warnings during execution. Default is `False`.
3323    set_up_start : str, optional
3324        Start date for the model spin-up period (YYYY-MM-DD). Default is `None`.
3325    set_up_end : str, optional
3326        End date for the model spin-up period (YYYY-MM-DD). Default is `None`.
3327    sim_start : str, optional
3328        Start date for the simulation period (YYYY-MM-DD). Default is `None`.
3329    sim_end : str, optional
3330        End date for the simulation period (YYYY-MM-DD). Default is `None`.
3331    freq : str, optional
3332        Simulation time step frequency (`"D"` for daily, `"M"` for monthly). Default is `"D"`.
3333    lat : float, optional
3334        Latitude of the catchment area for potential evapotranspiration calculation. Required for HBV simulations.
3335    area_cat : float, optional
3336        Total catchment area in km². Required for runoff scaling.
3337    area_glac : float, optional
3338        Glacierized area of the catchment in km². Default is `None`.
3339    ele_dat : float, optional
3340        Elevation of the meteorological station used for input data in meters. Default is `None`.
3341    ele_glac : float, optional
3342        Average elevation of the glacierized area in meters. Default is `None`.
3343    ele_cat : float, optional
3344        Average elevation of the entire catchment in meters. Default is `None`.
3345    plots : bool, optional
3346        Whether to generate plots. Default is `True`.
3347    plot_type : str, optional
3348        Type of plots to generate. Options are `"print"`, `"interactive"`, or `"all"`. Default is `"print"`.
3349    science_plot : bool, optional
3350        Whether to apply a scientific plot style using `scienceplot`package. Default is `True`.
3351    elev_rescaling : bool, optional
3352        Whether to perform annual elevation rescaling for glaciers. Default is `False`.
3353    drop_surplus : bool, optional
3354        Whether to drop surplus glacial mass balance during simulation. Default is `False`.
3355    **matilda_param : dict, optional
3356        Additional model parameters passed as key-value pairs. These override the default parameter values.
3357
3358    Returns
3359    -------
3360    list
3361        A list containing:
3362            - Compact MATILDA output (pandas.DataFrame).
3363            - Full MATILDA output (pandas.DataFrame).
3364            - Efficiency coefficient (str or float).
3365            - Model statistics (pandas.DataFrame).
3366            - Glacier lookup table (optional, str or pandas.DataFrame).
3367            - Glacier changes (optional, str or pandas.DataFrame).
3368
3369    Notes
3370    -----
3371    1. Outputs are saved to disk if `output` is specified.
3372    2. Observed runoff data, if provided, is included in the efficiency calculations and final outputs.
3373    3. Plots can be suppressed by setting `plots=False`.
3374    4. If `science_plot=True`, plots are styled with a scientific layout using the `science` and `no-latex` options.
3375    """
3376
3377    print("---")
3378    print("MATILDA framework")
3379    parameter = matilda_parameter(
3380        input_df,
3381        set_up_start=set_up_start,
3382        set_up_end=set_up_end,
3383        sim_start=sim_start,
3384        sim_end=sim_end,
3385        freq=freq,
3386        lat=lat,
3387        area_cat=area_cat,
3388        area_glac=area_glac,
3389        ele_dat=ele_dat,
3390        ele_glac=ele_glac,
3391        ele_cat=ele_cat,
3392        warn=warn,
3393        **matilda_param,
3394    )
3395
3396    # Data preprocessing with the MATILDA preparation script
3397    if obs is None:
3398        df_preproc = matilda_preproc(input_df, parameter)
3399        # Downscaling of data if necessary and the MATILDA simulation
3400        if glacier_profile is not None:
3401            output_MATILDA = matilda_submodules(
3402                df_preproc,
3403                parameter,
3404                glacier_profile=glacier_profile,
3405                elev_rescaling=elev_rescaling,
3406                drop_surplus=drop_surplus,
3407            )
3408        else:
3409            output_MATILDA = matilda_submodules(df_preproc, parameter)
3410    else:
3411        df_preproc, obs_preproc = matilda_preproc(input_df, parameter, obs=obs)
3412        # Scale data if necessary and run the MATILDA simulation
3413        if glacier_profile is not None:
3414            output_MATILDA = matilda_submodules(
3415                df_preproc,
3416                parameter,
3417                obs=obs_preproc,
3418                glacier_profile=glacier_profile,
3419                elev_rescaling=elev_rescaling,
3420                drop_surplus=drop_surplus,
3421            )
3422        else:
3423            output_MATILDA = matilda_submodules(df_preproc, parameter, obs=obs_preproc)
3424
3425    # Option to suppress plots.
3426    if plots:
3427        if science_plot:
3428            plt_style = ["science", "no-latex"]
3429            plt.style.use(plt_style)
3430
3431        output_MATILDA = matilda_plots(output_MATILDA, parameter, plot_type)
3432
3433    if output is not None:
3434        matilda_save_output(output_MATILDA, parameter, output, plot_type)
3435
3436    return output_MATILDA

   1# -*- coding: UTF-8 -*-
   2"""
   3MATILDA (Modeling wATer resources In gLacierizeD cAtchments) is a combination of a degree day model and the HBV model (Bergstöm 1976) to compute total runoff of glacierized catchments.
   4This file may use the input files created by the COSIPY-utility "aws2cosipy" as forcing data and or a simple dataframe with temperature, precipitation and if possible evapotranspiration and additional observation runoff data to validate it.
   5"""
   6# Import all necessary python packages
   7import sys
   8
   9import numpy
  10import xarray as xr
  11import numpy as np
  12import pandas as pd
  13import scipy.signal as ss

  15import hydroeval

  18warnings.filterwarnings(action='ignore' ,module='HydroErr')

  21import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
  22import matplotlib.dates as mdates
  23from matplotlib.offsetbox import AnchoredText

  25# Setting the parameter for the MATILDA simulation
  26def matilda_parameter(input_df, set_up_start=None, set_up_end=None, sim_start=None, sim_end=None, freq="D",
  27                      lat= None, area_cat=None, area_glac=None, ele_dat=None, ele_glac=None, ele_cat=None, parameter_df = None,
  28                      soi = None, warn = False, lr_temp=-0.006, lr_prec=0, \
  29                      hydro_year=10, TT_snow=0, TT_diff=2, CFMAX_snow=2.8, CFMAX_rel=2, \
  30                      BETA=1.0, CET=0.15, FC=250, K0=0.055, K1=0.055, K2=0.04, LP=0.7, MAXBAS=3.0, \
  31                      PERC=1.5, UZL=120, PCORR=1.0, SFCF=0.7, CWH=0.1, AG=0.7, RHO_snow=400,
  32                      # Constants
  33                      RHO_ice = 917,               # density of solid ice (kg/m^3)
  34                      CFR_ice = 0.01,               # fraction of ice melt refreezing in moulins,
  35                        **kwargs):
  36    """Creates a series from the provided and/or default parameters to be provided to all subsequent MATILDA modules."""
  37
  38    # Filter warnings:
  39    if not warn:
  40        warnings.filterwarnings(action='ignore')
  41
  42    # takes parameters directly from a dataframe, e.g. the output from SPOTPY
  43    if parameter_df is not None:
  44        parameter_df = parameter_df.set_index(parameter_df.columns[0])
  45        if "lr_temp" in parameter_df.index:
  46            lr_temp = parameter_df.loc["lr_temp"].values.item()
  47        if "lr_prec" in parameter_df.index:
  48            lr_prec = parameter_df.loc["lr_prec"].values.item()
  49        if "BETA" in parameter_df.index:
  50            BETA = parameter_df.loc["BETA"].values.item()
  51        if "CET" in parameter_df.index:
  52            CET = parameter_df.loc["CET"].values.item()
  53        if "FC" in parameter_df.index:
  54            FC = parameter_df.loc["FC"].values.item()
  55        if "K0" in parameter_df.index:
  56            K0 = parameter_df.loc["K0"].values.item()
  57        if "K1" in parameter_df.index:
  58            K1 = parameter_df.loc["K1"].values.item()
  59        if "K2" in parameter_df.index:
  60            K2 = parameter_df.loc["K2"].values.item()
  61        if "LP" in parameter_df.index:
  62            LP = parameter_df.loc["LP"].values.item()
  63        if "MAXBAS" in parameter_df.index:
  64            MAXBAS = parameter_df.loc["MAXBAS"].values.item()
  65        if "PERC" in parameter_df.index:
  66            PERC = parameter_df.loc["PERC"].values.item()
  67        if "UZL" in parameter_df.index:
  68            UZL = parameter_df.loc["UZL"].values.item()
  69        if "PCORR" in parameter_df.index:
  70            PCORR = parameter_df.loc["PCORR"].values.item()
  71        if "TT_snow" in parameter_df.index:
  72            TT_snow = parameter_df.loc["TT_snow"].values.item()
  73        if "TT_diff" in parameter_df.index:
  74            TT_diff = parameter_df.loc["TT_diff"].values.item()
  75        if "CFMAX_snow" in parameter_df.index:
  76            CFMAX_snow = parameter_df.loc["CFMAX_snow"].values.item()
  77        if "CFMAX_rel" in parameter_df.index:
  78            CFMAX_rel = parameter_df.loc["CFMAX_rel"].values.item()
  79        if "SFCF" in parameter_df.index:
  80            SFCF = parameter_df.loc["SFCF"].values.item()
  81        if "CFR_ice" in parameter_df.index:
  82            CFR_ice = parameter_df.loc["CFR_ice"].values.item()
  83        if "CWH" in parameter_df.index:
  84            CWH = parameter_df.loc["CWH"].values.item()
  85        if "AG" in parameter_df.index:
  86            AG = parameter_df.loc["AG"].values.item()
  87        if "RHO_snow" in parameter_df.index:
  88            RHO_snow = parameter_df.loc["RHO_snow"].values.item()
  89
  90    print("Reading parameters for MATILDA simulation")
  91    # Checking the parameters to set the catchment properties and simulation
  92    if lat is None:
  93        print("WARNING: No latitude specified. Please provide to calculate PE")
  94        return
  95    if area_cat is None:
  96        print("WARNING: No catchment area specified. Please provide catchment area in km2")
  97        return
  98    if area_glac > area_cat:
  99        print("WARNING: Glacier area exceeds overall catchment area")
 100    if ele_dat is not None and ele_cat is None:
 101        print("WARNING: Catchment reference elevation is missing")
 102    if area_glac is not None or area_glac > 0:
 103        if ele_glac is None and ele_dat is not None:
 104            print("WARNING: Glacier reference elevation is missing")
 105    if hydro_year > 12 and hydro_year < 1:
 106        print("WARNING: Beginning of hydrological year out of bounds [1, 12]")
 107
 108    if set_up_end is not None and sim_start is not None:
 109        if set_up_end > sim_start:
 110            print("WARNING: Set up period overlaps start of simulation period")
 111    if set_up_start is None and sim_start is None:
 112        set_up_start = input_df["TIMESTAMP"].iloc[0]
 113    if set_up_end is None and sim_end is None:
 114        set_up_end = pd.to_datetime(input_df["TIMESTAMP"].iloc[0])
 115        set_up_end = set_up_end + pd.DateOffset(years=1)
 116        set_up_end = str(set_up_end)
 117    if sim_start is None:
 118        sim_start = input_df["TIMESTAMP"].iloc[0]
 119    if sim_end is None:
 120        sim_end = input_df["TIMESTAMP"].iloc[-1]
 121    if set_up_start is None and sim_start is not None:
 122        if sim_start == input_df["TIMESTAMP"].iloc[0]:
 123            set_up_start = sim_start
 124        else:
 125            set_up_start = pd.to_datetime(sim_start) + pd.DateOffset(years=-1)
 126        set_up_end = pd.to_datetime(set_up_start) + pd.DateOffset(years=1) + pd.DateOffset(days=-1)
 127        set_up_start = str(set_up_start)
 128        set_up_end = str(set_up_end)
 129
 130    freq_long = ""
 131    if freq == "D":
 132        freq_long = "Daily"
 133    elif freq == "W":
 134        freq_long = "Weekly"
 135    elif freq == "M":
 136        freq_long = "Monthly"
 137    elif freq == "Y":
 138        freq_long = "Annual"
 139    else:
 140        print(
 141            "WARNING: Resampling rate " + freq + " is not supported. Choose either 'D' (daily), 'W' (weekly), 'M' (monthly) or 'Y' (yearly).")
 142
 143    # Check if season of interest is specified
 144    if soi is not None:
 145        if type(soi) is not list:
 146            print("Error: The season of interest (soi) needs to be specified as 2-element list: [first_calendar_month, last_calendar_month]")
 147            sys.exit()
 148        elif len(soi) is not 2:
 149            print("Error: The season of interest (soi) needs to be specified as 2-element list: [first_calendar_month, last_calendar_month]")
 150            sys.exit()
 151
 152
 153    # Check model parameters
 154    if -0.01 > lr_temp or lr_temp > -0.003:
 155        print("WARNING: Parameter lr_temp exceeds boundaries [-0.01, -0.003].")
 156    if 0 > lr_prec or lr_prec > 0.002:
 157        print("WARNING: Parameter lr_prec exceeds boundaries [0, 0.002].")
 158    if 1 > BETA or BETA > 6:
 159        print("WARNING: Parameter BETA exceeds boundaries [1, 6].")
 160    if 0 > CET or CET > 0.3:
 161        print("WARNING: Parameter CET exceeds boundaries [0, 0.3].")
 162    if 50 > FC or FC > 500:
 163        print("WARNING: Parameter FC exceeds boundaries [50, 500].")
 164    if 0.01 > K0 or K0 > 0.4:
 165        print("WARNING: Parameter K0 exceeds boundaries [0.01, 0.4].")
 166    if 0.01 > K1 or K1 > 0.4:
 167        print("WARNING: Parameter K1 exceeds boundaries [0.01, 0.4].")
 168    if 0.001 > K2 or K2 > 0.15:
 169        print("WARNING: Parameter K2 exceeds boundaries [0.001, 0.15].")
 170    if 0.3 > LP or LP > 1:
 171        print("WARNING: Parameter LP exceeds boundaries [0.3, 1].")
 172    if 1 >= MAXBAS or MAXBAS > 7:
 173        print("ERROR: Parameter MAXBAS exceeds boundaries [2, 7]. Please choose a suitable value.")
 174        return
 175    if 0 > PERC or PERC > 3:
 176        print("WARNING: Parameter PERC exceeds boundaries [0, 3].")
 177    if 0 > UZL or UZL > 500:
 178        print("WARNING: Parameter UZL exceeds boundaries [0, 500].")
 179    if 0.5 > PCORR or PCORR > 2:
 180        print("WARNING: Parameter PCORR exceeds boundaries [0.5, 2].")
 181    if -1.5 > TT_snow or TT_snow > 2.5:
 182        print("WARNING: Parameter TT_snow exceeds boundaries [-1.5, 2.5].")
 183    if 0.2 > TT_diff or TT_diff > 4:
 184        print("WARNING: Parameter TT_diff exceeds boundaries [0.2, 4].")
 185    if 1.2 > CFMAX_rel or CFMAX_rel > 2.5:
 186        print("WARNING: Parameter CFMAX_rel exceeds boundaries [1.2, 2.5].")
 187    if 1 > CFMAX_snow or CFMAX_snow > 10:
 188        print("WARNING: Parameter CFMAX_snow exceeds boundaries [1, 10].")
 189    if 0.4 > SFCF or SFCF > 1:
 190        print("WARNING: Parameter SFCF exceeds boundaries [0.4, 1].")
 191    if 0 > CWH or CWH > 0.2:
 192        print("WARNING: Parameter CWH exceeds boundaries [0, 0.2].")
 193    if 0 > AG or AG > 1:
 194        print("WARNING: Parameter AG exceeds boundaries [0, 1].")
 195    if 300 > RHO_snow or RHO_snow > 500:
 196        print("WARNING: Parameter RHO_snow exceeds boundaries [300, 500].")
 197    if RHO_ice != 917:
 198        print("ERROR: RHO_ice is a physical constant and shall not be changed.")
 199
 200    # calculate threshold temperature for rain
 201    TT_rain = TT_diff + TT_snow
 202
 203    # calculate ice melt factor:
 204    CFMAX_ice = CFMAX_rel * CFMAX_snow
 205
 206    # calculate ice fraction in snowpack
 207    theta_i = RHO_snow / RHO_ice
 208
 209    # calculate irreducible water content:
 210    if theta_i <= 0.23:
 211        theta_e = 0.0264 + 0.0099 * ((1 - theta_i) / theta_i)
 212    elif 0.23 < theta_i <= 0.812:
 213        theta_e = 0.08 - 0.1023 * (theta_i - 0.03)
 214    else:
 215        theta_e = 0
 216
 217    parameter = pd.Series(
 218        {"set_up_start": set_up_start, "set_up_end": set_up_end, "sim_start": sim_start, "sim_end": sim_end,
 219         "freq": freq, "freq_long": freq_long, "lat": lat, "area_cat": area_cat, "area_glac": area_glac,
 220         "ele_dat": ele_dat, "ele_glac": ele_glac, "ele_cat": ele_cat, "hydro_year": hydro_year, "soi": soi,
 221         "warn": warn, "lr_temp": lr_temp, "lr_prec": lr_prec, "TT_snow": TT_snow, "TT_rain": TT_rain, "TT_diff": TT_diff,
 222         "CFMAX_snow": CFMAX_snow, "CFMAX_ice": CFMAX_ice, "CFMAX_rel": CFMAX_rel, "BETA": BETA, "CET": CET,
 223         "FC": FC, "K0": K0, "K1": K1, "K2": K2, "LP": LP, "MAXBAS": MAXBAS, "PERC": PERC, "UZL": UZL,
 224         "PCORR": PCORR, "SFCF": SFCF, "CWH": CWH, "AG": AG, "RHO_snow": RHO_snow, "RHO_ice": RHO_ice,
 225         "CFR_ice": CFR_ice, "theta_e": theta_e})
 226    print("Parameters set")
 227    return parameter

 230def matilda_preproc(input_df, parameter, obs=None):
 231    """MATILDA preprocessing: transforms dataframes into the required format and converts the runoff observations unit from m3/s to mm/d."""
 232
 233    print("---")
 234    print("Reading data")
 235    print("Set up period from " + str(parameter.set_up_start) + " to " + str(parameter.set_up_end) + " to set initial values")
 236    print("Simulation period from " + str(parameter.sim_start) + " to " + str(parameter.sim_end))
 237    df_preproc = input_df.copy()
 238    if parameter.set_up_start > parameter.sim_start:
 239        print("WARNING: Spin up period starts after simulation period")
 240    elif isinstance(df_preproc, xr.Dataset):
 241        df_preproc = input_df.sel(time=slice(parameter.set_up_start, parameter.sim_end))
 242    else:
 243        df_preproc.set_index('TIMESTAMP', inplace=True)
 244        df_preproc.index = pd.to_datetime(df_preproc.index)
 245        df_preproc = df_preproc[parameter.set_up_start: parameter.sim_end]
 246    if obs is not None:
 247        obs_preproc = obs.copy()
 248        obs_preproc.set_index('Date', inplace=True)
 249        obs_preproc.index = pd.to_datetime(obs_preproc.index)
 250        obs_preproc = obs_preproc[parameter.sim_start: parameter.sim_end]
 251        # Changing the input unit from m/3 to mm.
 252        obs_preproc["Qobs"] = obs_preproc["Qobs"] * 86400 / (parameter.area_cat * 1000000) * 1000
 253        obs_preproc = obs_preproc.resample("D").agg(pd.Series.sum, skipna=False)
 254        # Omit everything outside the specified season of interest (soi)
 255        if parameter.soi is not None:
 256            obs_preproc = obs_preproc[obs_preproc.index.month.isin(range(parameter.soi[0], parameter.soi[1] + 1))]
 257        # Expanding the observation period to full years filling up with NAs
 258        idx_first = obs_preproc.index.year[1]
 259        idx_last = obs_preproc.index.year[-1]
 260        idx = pd.date_range(start=date(idx_first, 1, 1), end=date(idx_last, 12, 31), freq='D', name=obs_preproc.index.name)
 261        obs_preproc = obs_preproc.reindex(idx)
 262        obs_preproc = obs_preproc.fillna(np.NaN)
 263
 264
 265    if obs is not None:
 266        return df_preproc, obs_preproc
 267    if obs is None:
 268        return df_preproc

 271def glacier_elevscaling(df_preproc, parameter):
 272    """Scales the input data to mean catchment and mean glacier elevations respectively."""
 273
 274    if parameter.ele_glac is not None:
 275        elev_diff_glacier = parameter.ele_glac - parameter.ele_dat
 276        input_df_glacier = df_preproc.copy()
 277        input_df_glacier["T2"] = np.where(input_df_glacier["T2"] <= 100, input_df_glacier["T2"] + 273.15,
 278                                          input_df_glacier["T2"])
 279        input_df_glacier["T2"] = input_df_glacier["T2"] + elev_diff_glacier * float(parameter.lr_temp)
 280        input_df_glacier["RRR"] = input_df_glacier["RRR"] + elev_diff_glacier * float(parameter.lr_prec)
 281        input_df_glacier["RRR"] = np.where(input_df_glacier["RRR"] < 0, 0, input_df_glacier["RRR"])
 282    else:
 283        input_df_glacier = df_preproc.copy()
 284    if parameter.ele_cat is not None:
 285        height_diff_catchment = parameter.ele_cat - parameter.ele_dat
 286        input_df_catchment = df_preproc.copy()
 287        input_df_catchment["T2"] = np.where(input_df_catchment["T2"] <= 100, input_df_catchment["T2"] + 273.15,
 288                                            input_df_catchment["T2"])
 289        input_df_catchment["T2"] = input_df_catchment["T2"] + height_diff_catchment * float(parameter.lr_temp)
 290        input_df_catchment["RRR"] = input_df_catchment["RRR"] + height_diff_catchment * float(parameter.lr_prec)
 291        input_df_catchment["RRR"] = np.where(input_df_catchment["RRR"] < 0, 0, input_df_catchment["RRR"])
 292
 293    else:
 294        input_df_catchment = df_preproc.copy()
 295    return input_df_glacier, input_df_catchment

 298def calculate_PDD(ds):
 299    """Calculation of positive degree days in the provided timeseries."""
 300
 301    print("Calculating positive degree days")
 302    # masking the dataset to glacier area
 303    if isinstance(ds, xr.Dataset):
 304        mask = ds.MASK.values
 305        temp = xr.where(mask == 1, ds["T2"], np.nan)
 306        temp = temp.mean(dim=["lat", "lon"])
 307        temp = xr.where(temp >= 100, temp - 273.15, temp)  # making sure the temperature is in Celsius
 308        temp_min = temp.resample(time="D").min(dim="time")
 309        temp_max = temp.resample(time="D").max(dim="time")
 310        temp_mean = temp.resample(time="D").mean(dim="time")
 311        prec = xr.where(mask == 1, ds["RRR"], np.nan)
 312        prec = prec.mean(dim=["lat", "lon"])
 313        prec = prec.resample(time="D").sum(dim="time")
 314        time = temp_mean["time"]
 315    else:
 316        temp = ds["T2"]
 317        if temp[1] >= 100:  # making sure the temperature is in Celsius
 318            temp = temp - 273.15
 319        temp_min = temp.resample("D").min()
 320        temp_mean = temp.resample("D").mean()
 321        temp_max = temp.resample("D").max()
 322        prec = ds["RRR"].resample("D").sum()
 323
 324    pdd_ds = xr.merge([xr.DataArray(temp_mean, name="temp_mean"), xr.DataArray(temp_min, name="temp_min"), \
 325                       xr.DataArray(temp_max, name="temp_max"), xr.DataArray(prec)])
 326
 327    # calculate the positive degree days
 328    pdd_ds["pdd"] = xr.where(pdd_ds["temp_mean"] > 0, pdd_ds["temp_mean"], 0)
 329
 330    return pdd_ds

 333def melt_rates(snow, pdd, parameter):
 334    """ pypdd.py line 331
 335        Compute melt rates from snow precipitation and pdd sum.
 336        Snow melt is computed from the number of positive degree days (*pdd*)
 337        and the `pdd_factor_snow` model attribute. If all snow is melted and
 338        some energy (PDD) remains, ice melt is computed using `pdd_factor_ice`.
 339        *snow*: array_like
 340            Snow precipitation rate.
 341        *pdd*: array_like
 342            Number of positive degree days."""
 343
 344    # compute a potential snow melt
 345    pot_snow_melt = parameter.CFMAX_snow * pdd
 346    # effective snow melt can't exceed amount of snow
 347    snow_melt = np.minimum(snow, pot_snow_melt)
 348    # ice melt is proportional to excess snow melt
 349    ice_melt = (pot_snow_melt - snow_melt) * parameter.CFMAX_ice / parameter.CFMAX_snow
 350    # return melt rates
 351    return (snow_melt, ice_melt)
 352
 353
 354def calculate_glaciermelt(ds, parameter):
 355    """Degree Day Model to calculate the accumulation, snow and ice melt and runoff rate from the glaciers.
 356    Roughly based on PYPDD (github.com/juseg/pypdd)
 357    - # Copyright (c) 2013--2018, Julien Seguinot <seguinot@vaw.baug.ethz.ch>)
 358    pypdd.py line 311
 359        Compute accumulation rate from temperature and precipitation.
 360        The fraction of precipitation that falls as snow decreases linearly
 361        from one to zero between temperature thresholds defined by the
 362        `temp_snow` and `temp_rain` attributes. """
 363
 364    print("Calculating glacial melt")
 365
 366    # initialize arrays
 367    temp = ds["temp_mean"]
 368    prec = ds["RRR"]
 369    pdd = ds["pdd"]
 370    snow_depth = xr.zeros_like(temp)
 371    snow_melt = xr.zeros_like(temp)
 372    ice_melt = xr.zeros_like(temp)
 373    actual_runoff = xr.zeros_like(temp)
 374    glacier_reservoir = xr.zeros_like(temp)
 375
 376    # calculate accumulation (SWE)
 377    reduced_temp = (parameter.TT_rain - temp) / (parameter.TT_rain - parameter.TT_snow)
 378    snowfrac = np.clip(reduced_temp, 0, 1)
 379    accu_rate = snowfrac * prec
 380
 381    # compute snow depth and melt rates
 382    for i in np.arange(len(temp)):
 383        if i > 0:
 384            snow_depth[i] = snow_depth[i - 1]
 385        snow_depth[i] += accu_rate[i]
 386        snow_melt[i], ice_melt[i] = melt_rates(snow_depth[i], pdd[i], parameter)
 387        snow_depth[i] -= snow_melt[i]
 388
 389    # calculate refreezing, runoff and surface mass balance
 390    total_melt = snow_melt + ice_melt
 391    refr_ice = parameter.CFR_ice * ice_melt
 392    refr_snow = parameter.theta_e * snow_melt
 393    runoff_rate = total_melt - refr_snow - refr_ice
 394    inst_smb = accu_rate - runoff_rate
 395
 396    # Storage-release scheme for glacier outflow (Stahl et.al. 2008, Toum et. al. 2021)
 397    KG_min = 0.1  # minimum outflow coefficient (conditions with deep snow and poorly developed glacial drainage systems) [time^−1]
 398    d_KG = 0.9  # KG_min + d_KG = maximum outflow coefficient (representing late-summer conditions with bare ice and a well developed glacial drainage system) [time^−1]
 399    KG = np.minimum(KG_min + d_KG * np.exp(snow_depth / -(0.1 * 1000000**parameter.AG)), 1)
 400    for i in np.arange(len(temp)):
 401        if i == 0:
 402            SG = runoff_rate[i]  # liquid water stored in the reservoir
 403        else:
 404            SG = np.maximum((runoff_rate[i] - actual_runoff[i - 1]) + SG, 0)
 405        actual_runoff[i] = KG[i] * SG
 406        glacier_reservoir[i] = SG
 407
 408    # final glacier module output
 409    glacier_melt = xr.merge(
 410        [xr.DataArray(inst_smb, name="DDM_smb"),
 411         xr.DataArray(pdd, name="pdd"),
 412         xr.DataArray(accu_rate, name="DDM_accumulation_rate"),
 413         xr.DataArray(ice_melt, name="DDM_ice_melt"),
 414         xr.DataArray(snow_melt, name="DDM_snow_melt"),
 415         xr.DataArray(total_melt, name="DDM_total_melt"),
 416         xr.DataArray(refr_ice, name="DDM_refreezing_ice"),
 417         xr.DataArray(refr_snow, name="DDM_refreezing_snow"),
 418         xr.DataArray(glacier_reservoir, name="DDM_glacier_reservoir"),
 419         xr.DataArray(actual_runoff, name='Q_DDM')
 420         ])
 421
 422    DDM_results = glacier_melt.to_dataframe()
 423    print("Finished Degree-Day Melt Routine")
 424    return DDM_results
 425
 426
 427def create_lookup_table(glacier_profile, parameter):
 428    """ Part 1 of the glacier scaling routine based on the deltaH approach outlined in Seibert et al. (2018) and
 429    Huss and al.(2010). Creates a look-up table of glacier area and water equivalent from the initial state (100%)
 430    to an ice-free catchment (0%) in steps of 1%."""
 431
 432    initial_area = glacier_profile["Area"]  # per elevation band
 433    hi_initial = glacier_profile["WE"]  # initial water equivalent of each elevation band
 434    hi_k = glacier_profile["WE"]  # hi_k is the updated water equivalent for each elevation zone, starts with initial values
 435    ai = glacier_profile["Area"]  # ai is the glacier area of each elevation zone, starts with initial values
 436
 437    lookup_table = pd.DataFrame()
 438    lookup_table = lookup_table.append(initial_area, ignore_index=True)
 439
 440    # Pre-simulation
 441    # 1. calculate total glacier mass in mm water equivalent: M = sum(ai * hi)
 442    m = sum(glacier_profile["Area"] * glacier_profile["WE"])
 443
 444    # melt the glacier in steps of 1 percent
 445    deltaM = -m / 100
 446
 447    # 2. Normalize glacier elevations: Einorm = (Emax-Ei)/(Emax-Emin)
 448    glacier_profile["norm_elevation"] = (glacier_profile["Elevation"].max() - glacier_profile["Elevation"]) / \
 449                                        (glacier_profile["Elevation"].max() - glacier_profile["Elevation"].min())
 450    # 3. Apply deltaH parameterization: deltahi = (Einorm+a)^y + b*(Einorm+a) + c
 451    # deltahi is the normalized (dimensionless) ice thickness change of elevation band i
 452    # choose one of the three parameterizations from Huss et al. (2010) depending on glacier size
 453    if parameter.area_glac < 5:
 454        a = -0.3
 455        b = 0.6
 456        c = 0.09
 457        y = 2
 458    elif parameter.area_glac < 20:
 459        a = -0.05
 460        b = 0.19
 461        c = 0.01
 462        y = 4
 463    else:
 464        a = -0.02
 465        b = 0.12
 466        c = 0
 467        y = 6
 468
 469    glacier_profile["delta_h"] = (glacier_profile["norm_elevation"] + a) ** y + (
 470                b * (glacier_profile["norm_elevation"] + a)) + c
 471
 472    ai_scaled = ai.copy()  # setting ai_scaled with the initial values
 473
 474    fs = deltaM / (sum(ai * glacier_profile["delta_h"]))  # a) initial ai
 475
 476    for _ in range(99):
 477        # 5. compute glacier geometry for reduced mass
 478        hi_k = hi_k + fs * glacier_profile["delta_h"]
 479
 480        leftover = sum(pd.Series(np.where(hi_k < 0, hi_k, 0)) * ai)  # Calculate leftover (i.e. the 'negative' glacier volume)
 481
 482        hi_k = pd.Series(np.where(hi_k < 0, np.nan, hi_k))  # Set those zones that have a negative weq to NaN to make sure they will be excluded from now on
 483
 484        # 6. width scaling
 485        ai_scaled = ai * np.sqrt((hi_k / hi_initial))
 486
 487        # 7. create lookup table
 488        # glacier area for each elevation band for 101 different mass situations (100 percent to 0 in 1 percent steps)
 489
 490        lookup_table = lookup_table.append(ai_scaled, ignore_index=True)
 491
 492        if sum(pd.Series(np.where(np.isnan(ai_scaled), 0, ai)) * glacier_profile["delta_h"]) == 0:
 493            ai_scaled = np.where(ai_scaled == 1, 1, 0)
 494        else:
 495            # Update fs (taking into account the leftover)
 496            fs = (deltaM + leftover) / sum(
 497                pd.Series(np.where(np.isnan(ai_scaled), 0, ai)) * glacier_profile["delta_h"])
 498
 499    lookup_table = lookup_table.fillna(0)
 500
 501    lookup_table.columns = glacier_profile["EleZone"]
 502    lookup_table = lookup_table.groupby(level=0, axis=1).sum()
 503
 504    elezones_inital = lookup_table.iloc[0]
 505
 506    lookup_table = lookup_table / elezones_inital
 507    lookup_table = round(lookup_table, 4)
 508    lookup_table.iloc[-1] = 0
 509    return lookup_table
 510
 511
 512def glacier_change(output_DDM, lookup_table, glacier_profile, parameter):
 513    """ Part 2 of the glacier scaling routine based on the deltaH approach outlined in Seibert et al. (2018) and
 514    Huss and al.(2010). Calculates the new glacier area for each hydrological year."""
 515
 516    # creating the column for the updated runoff
 517    output_DDM["Q_DDM_updated_scaled"] = copy.deepcopy(output_DDM["Q_DDM"])
 518
 519    # determining from when to when the hydrological year is
 520    output_DDM["water_year"] = np.where((output_DDM.index.month) >= parameter.hydro_year, output_DDM.index.year + 1,
 521                                        output_DDM.index.year)
 522    # initial smb from the glacier routine script in m w.e.
 523    m = sum((glacier_profile["Area"]) * glacier_profile["WE"])
 524    m = m / 1000 # in m
 525    # initial area
 526    initial_area = glacier_profile.groupby("EleZone")["Area"].sum()
 527    # dataframe with the smb change per hydrological year in m w.e.
 528    glacier_change = pd.DataFrame({"smb": output_DDM.groupby("water_year")["DDM_smb"].sum() / 1000 * 0.9}).reset_index()  # do we have to scale this?
 529
 530    glacier_change_area = pd.DataFrame({"time":"initial", "glacier_area":[parameter.area_glac]})
 531
 532    # setting initial values for the loop
 533    new_area = parameter.area_glac
 534    smb_sum = 0
 535    i = 1
 536    for i in range(len(glacier_change)):
 537        year = glacier_change["water_year"][i]
 538        smb = glacier_change["smb"][i]
 539        # scaling the smb to the catchment
 540        smb = smb * (new_area / parameter.area_cat)
 541        # adding the smb from the previous year(s) to the new year
 542        smb_sum = smb_sum + smb
 543        # calculating the percentage of melt in comparison to the initial mass
 544        smb_percentage = round((-smb_sum / m) * 100)
 545        if (smb_percentage <= 99) & (smb_percentage >= 0):
 546            # getting the correct row from the lookup table depending on the smb
 547            area_melt = lookup_table.iloc[smb_percentage]
 548            # getting the new glacier area by multiplying the initial area with the area changes
 549            new_area = np.nansum((area_melt.values * initial_area.values))*parameter.area_cat
 550        else:
 551            new_area = 0
 552        # scaling the output with the new glacierized area
 553        glacier_change_area = glacier_change_area.append({'time': year, "glacier_area":new_area, "smb_sum":smb_sum}, ignore_index=True)
 554        output_DDM["Q_DDM_updated_scaled"] = np.where(output_DDM["water_year"] == year, output_DDM["Q_DDM"] * (new_area / parameter.area_cat), output_DDM["Q_DDM_updated_scaled"])
 555
 556    return output_DDM, glacier_change_area
 557
 558
 559def hbv_simulation(input_df_catchment, parameter, glacier_area=None):
 560        """Compute the runoff from the catchment with the HBV model
 561            Python Code based on the LHMP (github.com/hydrogo/LHMP -
 562            Ayzel Georgy. (2016). LHMP: lumped hydrological modelling playground. Zenodo. doi: 10.5281/zenodo.59501)
 563            For the HBV model, evapotranspiration values are needed. If none provided these are calculated as suggested by Oudin et al. (2005)
 564            in mm/day."""
 565
 566        print("Running HBV routine")
 567        # 1. new temporary dataframe from input with daily values
 568        if "PE" in input_df_catchment.columns:
 569            input_df_hbv = input_df_catchment.resample("D").agg({"T2": 'mean', "RRR": 'sum', "PE": "sum"})
 570        else:
 571            input_df_hbv = input_df_catchment.resample("D").agg({"T2": 'mean', "RRR": 'sum'})
 572
 573        Temp = input_df_hbv['T2']
 574        if Temp[1] >= 100:  # making sure the temperature is in Celsius
 575            Temp = Temp - 273.15
 576        Prec = input_df_hbv['RRR']
 577
 578        # Calculation of PE with Oudin et al. 2005
 579        # solar_constant = (1376 * 1000000) / 86400  # from 1376 J/m2s to MJm2d
 580        latent_heat_flux = 2.45
 581        water_density = 1000
 582        if "PE" in input_df_catchment.columns:
 583            Evap = input_df_hbv["PE"]
 584        else:
 585            doy = np.array(input_df_hbv.index.strftime('%j')).astype(int)
 586            lat = np.deg2rad(parameter.lat)
 587            # Part 2. Extraterrrestrial radiation calculation
 588            # set solar constant (in W m-2)
 589            Rsc = 1367  # solar constant (in W m-2)
 590            # calculate solar declination dt (in radians)
 591            dt = 0.409 * np.sin(2 * np.pi / 365 * doy - 1.39)
 592            # calculate sunset hour angle (in radians)
 593            ws = np.arccos(-np.tan(lat) * np.tan(dt))
 594            # Calculate sunshine duration N (in hours)
 595            N = 24 / np.pi * ws
 596            # Calculate day angle j (in radians)
 597            j = 2 * np.pi / 365.25 * doy
 598            # Calculate relative distance to sun
 599            dr = 1.0 + 0.03344 * np.cos(j - 0.048869)
 600            # Calculate extraterrestrial radiation (J m-2 day-1)
 601            Re = Rsc * 86400 / np.pi * dr * (ws * np.sin(lat) * np.sin(dt) \
 602                                             + np.sin(ws) * np.cos(lat) * np.cos(dt))
 603            # convert from J m-2 day-1 to MJ m-2 day-1
 604            Re = Re / 10 ** 6
 605
 606            Evap = np.where(Temp + 5 > 0, (Re / (water_density * latent_heat_flux)) * ((Temp + 5) / 100) * 1000, 0)
 607
 608            Evap = pd.Series(Evap, index=input_df_hbv.index)
 609            input_df_hbv["PE"] = Evap
 610
 611        # 2. Set-up period:
 612        # 2.1 meteorological forcing preprocessing
 613        Temp_cal = Temp[parameter.set_up_start:parameter.set_up_end]
 614        Prec_cal = Prec[parameter.set_up_start:parameter.set_up_end]
 615        Evap_cal = Evap[parameter.set_up_start:parameter.set_up_end]
 616        # overall correction factor
 617        Prec_cal = parameter.PCORR * Prec_cal
 618        Prec_cal = np.where(Prec_cal < 0, 0, Prec_cal)
 619        # precipitation separation
 620        # if T < parTT: SNOW, else RAIN
 621        RAIN_cal = np.where(Temp_cal > parameter.TT_rain, Prec_cal, 0)
 622        # SNOW_cal2 = np.where(Temp_cal <= parTT, Prec_cal, 0)
 623        reduced_temp_cal = (parameter.TT_rain - Temp_cal) / (parameter.TT_rain - parameter.TT_snow)
 624        snowfrac_cal = np.clip(reduced_temp_cal, 0, 1)
 625        SNOW_cal = snowfrac_cal * Prec_cal
 626        # snow correction factor
 627        SNOW_cal = parameter.SFCF * SNOW_cal
 628        # get the new glacier area for each year
 629        if glacier_area is not None:
 630            glacier_area = glacier_area.iloc[1:, :]
 631            glacier_area["time"] = glacier_area["time"].astype(str).astype(float).astype(int)
 632            SNOW2 = pd.DataFrame(SNOW_cal)
 633            SNOW2["area"] = 0
 634            for year in range(len(glacier_area)):
 635                SNOW2["area"] = np.where(SNOW2.index.year == glacier_area["time"].iloc[year],
 636                                         glacier_area["glacier_area"].iloc[year],
 637                                         SNOW2["area"])
 638
 639            SNOW2["T2"] = SNOW2["T2"] * (1 - (SNOW2["area"] / parameter.area_cat))
 640            SNOW_cal = SNOW2['T2'].squeeze()
 641        else:
 642            SNOW_cal = SNOW_cal * (1 - (parameter.area_glac / parameter.area_cat))
 643        # evaporation correction
 644        # a. calculate long-term averages of daily temperature
 645        Temp_mean_cal = np.array([Temp_cal.loc[Temp_cal.index.dayofyear == x].mean() \
 646                                  for x in range(1, 367)])
 647        # b. correction of Evaporation daily values
 648        Evap_cal = Evap_cal.index.map(
 649            lambda x: (1 + parameter.CET * (Temp_cal[x] - Temp_mean_cal[x.dayofyear - 1])) * Evap_cal[x])
 650        # c. control Evaporation
 651        Evap_cal = np.where(Evap_cal > 0, Evap_cal, 0)
 652
 653        # 2.2 Initial parameter calibration
 654        # snowpack box
 655        SNOWPACK_cal = np.zeros(len(Prec_cal))
 656        SNOWPACK_cal[0] = 0.0001
 657        # meltwater box
 658        SNOWMELT_cal = np.zeros(len(Prec_cal))
 659        SNOWMELT_cal[0] = 0.0001
 660        # soil moisture box
 661        SM_cal = np.zeros(len(Prec_cal))
 662        SM_cal[0] = 0.0001
 663        # actual evaporation
 664        ETact_cal = np.zeros(len(Prec_cal))
 665        ETact_cal[0] = 0.0001
 666
 667        # 2.3 Running model for set-up period
 668        for t in range(1, len(Prec_cal)):
 669
 670            # 2.3.1 Snow routine
 671            # how snowpack forms
 672            SNOWPACK_cal[t] = SNOWPACK_cal[t - 1] + SNOW_cal[t]
 673            # how snowpack melts
 674            # day-degree simple melting
 675            melt = parameter.CFMAX_snow * (Temp_cal[t] - parameter.TT_snow)
 676            # control melting
 677            if melt < 0: melt = 0
 678            melt = min(melt, SNOWPACK_cal[t])
 679            # how meltwater box forms
 680            SNOWMELT_cal[t] = SNOWMELT_cal[t - 1] + melt
 681            # snowpack after melting
 682            SNOWPACK_cal[t] = SNOWPACK_cal[t] - melt
 683            # refreezing accounting
 684            refreezing = parameter.theta_e * parameter.CFMAX_snow * (parameter.TT_snow - Temp_cal[t])
 685            # control refreezing
 686            if refreezing < 0: refreezing = 0
 687            refreezing = min(refreezing, SNOWMELT_cal[t])
 688            # snowpack after refreezing
 689            SNOWPACK_cal[t] = SNOWPACK_cal[t] + refreezing
 690            # meltwater after refreezing
 691            SNOWMELT_cal[t] = SNOWMELT_cal[t] - refreezing
 692            # recharge to soil
 693            tosoil = SNOWMELT_cal[t] - (parameter.CWH * SNOWPACK_cal[t]);
 694            # control recharge to soil
 695            if tosoil < 0: tosoil = 0
 696            # meltwater after recharge to soil
 697            SNOWMELT_cal[t] = SNOWMELT_cal[t] - tosoil
 698
 699            # 2.3.1 Soil and evaporation routine
 700            # soil wetness calculation
 701            soil_wetness = (SM_cal[t - 1] / parameter.FC) ** parameter.BETA
 702            # control soil wetness (should be in [0, 1])
 703            if soil_wetness < 0: soil_wetness = 0
 704            if soil_wetness > 1: soil_wetness = 1
 705            # soil recharge
 706            recharge = (RAIN_cal[t] + tosoil) * soil_wetness
 707            # soil moisture update
 708            SM_cal[t] = SM_cal[t - 1] + RAIN_cal[t] + tosoil - recharge
 709            # excess of water calculation
 710            excess = SM_cal[t] - parameter.FC
 711            # control excess
 712            if excess < 0: excess = 0
 713            # soil moisture update
 714            SM_cal[t] = SM_cal[t] - excess
 715
 716            # evaporation accounting
 717            evapfactor = SM_cal[t] / (parameter.LP * parameter.FC)
 718            # control evapfactor in range [0, 1]
 719            if evapfactor < 0: evapfactor = 0
 720            if evapfactor > 1: evapfactor = 1
 721            # calculate actual evaporation
 722            ETact_cal[t] = Evap_cal[t] * evapfactor
 723            # control actual evaporation
 724            ETact_cal[t] = min(SM_cal[t], ETact_cal[t])
 725
 726            # last soil moisture updating
 727            SM_cal[t] = SM_cal[t] - ETact_cal[t]
 728        print("Finished spin up for initial HBV parameters")
 729
 730        # 3. meteorological forcing preprocessing for simulation
 731        Temp = Temp[parameter.sim_start:parameter.sim_end]
 732        Prec = Prec[parameter.sim_start:parameter.sim_end]
 733        Evap = Evap[parameter.sim_start:parameter.sim_end]
 734        # overall correction factor
 735        Prec = parameter.PCORR * Prec
 736        Prec = np.where(Prec < 0, 0, Prec)
 737        # precipitation separation
 738        # if T < parTT: SNOW, else RAIN
 739        RAIN = np.where(Temp > parameter.TT_snow, Prec, 0)
 740        # SNOW = np.where(Temp <= parTT, Prec, 0)
 741        reduced_temp = (parameter.TT_rain - Temp) / (parameter.TT_rain - parameter.TT_snow)
 742        snowfrac = np.clip(reduced_temp, 0, 1)
 743        SNOW = snowfrac * Prec
 744        # snow correction factor
 745        SNOW = parameter.SFCF * SNOW
 746        # get the new glacier area for each year
 747        if glacier_area is not None:
 748            glacier_area = glacier_area.iloc[1:, :]
 749            glacier_area["time"] = glacier_area["time"].astype(str).astype(float).astype(int)
 750            SNOW2 = pd.DataFrame(SNOW)
 751            SNOW2["area"] = 0
 752            for year in range(len(glacier_area)):
 753                SNOW2["area"] = np.where(SNOW2.index.year == glacier_area["time"].iloc[year],
 754                                         glacier_area["glacier_area"].iloc[year],
 755                                         SNOW2["area"])
 756
 757            SNOW2["T2"] = SNOW2["T2"] * (1 - (SNOW2["area"] / parameter.area_cat))
 758            SNOW = SNOW2['T2'].squeeze()
 759        else:
 760            SNOW = SNOW * (1 - (parameter.area_glac / parameter.area_cat))  # evaporation correction
 761        # a. calculate long-term averages of daily temperature
 762        Temp_mean = np.array([Temp.loc[Temp.index.dayofyear == x].mean() \
 763                              for x in range(1, 367)])
 764        # b. correction of Evaporation daily values
 765        Evap = Evap.index.map(lambda x: (1 + parameter.CET * (Temp[x] - Temp_mean[x.dayofyear - 1])) * Evap[x])
 766        # c. control Evaporation
 767        Evap = np.where(Evap > 0, Evap, 0)
 768
 769        # 4. initialize boxes and initial conditions after calibration
 770        # snowpack box
 771        SNOWPACK = np.zeros(len(Prec))
 772        SNOWPACK[0] = SNOWPACK_cal[-1]
 773        # meltwater box
 774        SNOWMELT = np.zeros(len(Prec))
 775        SNOWMELT[0] = 0.0001
 776        # soil moisture box
 777        SM = np.zeros(len(Prec))
 778        SM[0] = SM_cal[-1]
 779        # soil upper zone box
 780        SUZ = np.zeros(len(Prec))
 781        SUZ[0] = 0.0001
 782        # soil lower zone box
 783        SLZ = np.zeros(len(Prec))
 784        SLZ[0] = 0.0001
 785        # actual evaporation
 786        ETact = np.zeros(len(Prec))
 787        ETact[0] = 0.0001
 788        # simulated runoff box
 789        Qsim = np.zeros(len(Prec))
 790        Qsim[0] = 0.0001
 791
 792        # 5. The main cycle of calculations
 793        for t in range(1, len(Qsim)):
 794            # 5.1 Snow routine
 795            # how snowpack forms
 796            SNOWPACK[t] = SNOWPACK[t - 1] + SNOW[t]
 797            # how snowpack melts
 798            # temperature index melting (PDD)
 799            melt = parameter.CFMAX_snow * (Temp[t] - parameter.TT_snow)
 800            # control melting
 801            if melt < 0: melt = 0
 802            melt = min(melt, SNOWPACK[t])
 803            # how meltwater box forms
 804            SNOWMELT[t] = SNOWMELT[t - 1] + melt
 805            # snowpack after melting
 806            SNOWPACK[t] = SNOWPACK[t] - melt
 807            # refreezing accounting
 808            refreezing = parameter.theta_e * parameter.CFMAX_snow * (parameter.TT_snow - Temp[t])
 809            # control refreezing
 810            if refreezing < 0: refreezing = 0
 811            refreezing = min(refreezing, SNOWMELT[t])
 812            # snowpack after refreezing
 813            SNOWPACK[t] = SNOWPACK[t] + refreezing
 814            # meltwater after refreezing
 815            SNOWMELT[t] = SNOWMELT[t] - refreezing
 816            # recharge to soil
 817            tosoil = SNOWMELT[t] - (parameter.CWH * SNOWPACK[t])
 818            # control recharge to soil
 819            if tosoil < 0: tosoil = 0
 820            # meltwater after recharge to soil
 821            SNOWMELT[t] = SNOWMELT[t] - tosoil
 822
 823            # 5.2 Soil and evaporation routine
 824            # soil wetness calculation
 825            soil_wetness = (SM[t - 1] / parameter.FC) ** parameter.BETA
 826            # control soil wetness (should be in [0, 1])
 827            if soil_wetness < 0: soil_wetness = 0
 828            if soil_wetness > 1: soil_wetness = 1
 829            # soil recharge
 830            recharge = (RAIN[t] + tosoil) * soil_wetness
 831            # soil moisture update
 832            SM[t] = SM[t - 1] + RAIN[t] + tosoil - recharge
 833            # excess of water calculation
 834            excess = SM[t] - parameter.FC
 835            # control excess
 836            if excess < 0: excess = 0
 837            # soil moisture update
 838            SM[t] = SM[t] - excess
 839
 840            # evaporation accounting
 841            evapfactor = SM[t] / (parameter.LP * parameter.FC)
 842            # control evapfactor in range [0, 1]
 843            if evapfactor < 0: evapfactor = 0
 844            if evapfactor > 1: evapfactor = 1
 845            # calculate actual evaporation
 846            ETact[t] = Evap[t] * evapfactor
 847            # control actual evaporation
 848            ETact[t] = min(SM[t], ETact[t])
 849
 850            # last soil moisture updating
 851            SM[t] = SM[t] - ETact[t]
 852
 853            # 5.3 Groundwater routine
 854            # upper groundwater box
 855            SUZ[t] = SUZ[t - 1] + recharge + excess
 856            # percolation control
 857            perc = min(SUZ[t], parameter.PERC)
 858            # update upper groundwater box
 859            SUZ[t] = SUZ[t] - perc
 860            # runoff from the highest part of upper groundwater box (surface runoff)
 861            Q0 = parameter.K0 * max(SUZ[t] - parameter.UZL, 0)
 862            # update upper groundwater box
 863            SUZ[t] = SUZ[t] - Q0
 864            # runoff from the middle part of upper groundwater box
 865            Q1 = parameter.K1 * SUZ[t]
 866            # update upper groundwater box
 867            SUZ[t] = SUZ[t] - Q1
 868            # calculate lower groundwater box
 869            SLZ[t] = SLZ[t - 1] + perc
 870            # runoff from lower groundwater box
 871            Q2 = parameter.K2 * SLZ[t]
 872            # update lower groundwater box
 873            SLZ[t] = SLZ[t] - Q2
 874
 875            # Total runoff calculation
 876            Qsim[t] = Q0 + Q1 + Q2
 877
 878        # 6. Scale effect accounting
 879        # delay and smoothing simulated hydrograph
 880        # (Beck et al.,2016) used triangular transformation based on moving window
 881        # here are my method with simple forward filter based on Butterworth filter design
 882        # calculate Numerator (b) and denominator (a) polynomials of the IIR filter
 883        parMAXBAS = int(parameter.MAXBAS)
 884        b, a = ss.butter(parMAXBAS, 1 / parMAXBAS)
 885        # implement forward filter
 886        Qsim_smoothed = ss.lfilter(b, a, Qsim)
 887        # control smoothed runoff
 888        Qsim_smoothed = np.where(Qsim_smoothed > 0, Qsim_smoothed, 0)
 889
 890        Qsim = Qsim_smoothed
 891        hbv_results = pd.DataFrame(
 892            {"T2": Temp, "RRR": Prec, "PE": Evap, "HBV_snowpack": SNOWPACK, "HBV_soil_moisture": SM, "HBV_AET": ETact, \
 893             "HBV_upper_gw": SUZ, "HBV_lower_gw": SLZ, "Q_HBV": Qsim},
 894            index=input_df_hbv[parameter.sim_start: parameter.sim_end].index)
 895        print("Finished HBV routine")
 896        return hbv_results
 897

 899def create_statistics(output_MATILDA):
 900    stats = output_MATILDA.describe()
 901    sum = pd.DataFrame(output_MATILDA.sum())
 902    sum.columns = ["sum"]
 903    sum = sum.transpose()
 904    stats = stats.append(sum)
 905    stats = stats.round(3)
 906    return stats

 909def matilda_submodules(df_preproc, parameter, obs=None, glacier_profile=None):
 910    """The main MATILDA simulation. It consists of linear scaling of the data (if elevations for data, catchment and glacier
 911    are provided) and executes the DDM and HBV modules subsequently."""
 912
 913    # Filter warnings:
 914    if not parameter.warn:
 915        warnings.filterwarnings(action='ignore')
 916
 917    print('---')
 918    print('Initiating MATILDA simulation')
 919
 920    # Scale input data to fit catchments elevations
 921    if parameter.ele_dat is not None:
 922        input_df_glacier, input_df_catchment = glacier_elevscaling(df_preproc, parameter)
 923    else:
 924        input_df_glacier = df_preproc.copy()
 925        input_df_catchment = df_preproc.copy()
 926
 927    input_df_glacier = input_df_glacier[parameter.sim_start:parameter.sim_end]
 928
 929    # Execute DDM module
 930    if parameter.area_glac > 0:
 931        degreedays_ds = calculate_PDD(input_df_glacier)
 932        output_DDM = calculate_glaciermelt(degreedays_ds, parameter)
 933
 934    # Execute glacier re-scaling module
 935    if parameter.area_glac > 0:
 936        if glacier_profile is not None:
 937            lookup_table = create_lookup_table(glacier_profile, parameter)
 938            output_DDM, glacier_change_area = glacier_change(output_DDM, lookup_table, glacier_profile, parameter)
 939        else:
 940            # scaling glacier melt to glacier area
 941            output_DDM["Q_DDM_scaled"] = output_DDM["Q_DDM"] * (parameter.area_glac / parameter.area_cat)
 942            lookup_table = str("No lookup table generated")
 943            glacier_change_area = str("No glacier changes calculated")
 944    else:
 945        lookup_table = str("No lookup table generated")
 946        glacier_change_area = str("No glacier changes calculated")
 947
 948    # Execute HBV module:
 949    if glacier_profile is not None:
 950        output_HBV = hbv_simulation(input_df_catchment, parameter, glacier_area=glacier_change_area)
 951    else:
 952        output_HBV = hbv_simulation(input_df_catchment, parameter)
 953    output_HBV = output_HBV[parameter.sim_start:parameter.sim_end]
 954
 955    # Output postprocessing
 956    if parameter.area_glac > 0:
 957        output_MATILDA = pd.concat([output_HBV, output_DDM], axis=1)
 958    else:
 959        output_MATILDA = output_HBV.copy()
 960
 961    if obs is not None:
 962        output_MATILDA = pd.concat([output_MATILDA, obs], axis=1)
 963
 964    if parameter.area_glac > 0:
 965        if glacier_profile is not None:
 966            output_MATILDA["Q_Total"] = output_MATILDA["Q_HBV"] + output_MATILDA["Q_DDM_updated_scaled"]
 967        else:
 968            output_MATILDA["Q_Total"] = output_MATILDA["Q_HBV"] + output_MATILDA["Q_DDM_scaled"]
 969    else:
 970        output_MATILDA["Q_Total"] = output_MATILDA["Q_HBV"]
 971
 972    output_MATILDA = output_MATILDA[parameter.sim_start:parameter.sim_end]
 973
 974    # if obs is not None:
 975    #     output_MATILDA.loc[output_MATILDA.isnull().any(axis=1), :] = np.nan
 976
 977    # Model efficiency coefficients
 978    if obs is not None:
 979        sim = output_MATILDA["Q_Total"]
 980        target = output_MATILDA["Qobs"]
 981        if parameter.freq == "D":
 982            nash_sut = he.nse(sim, target, remove_zero=True)
 983            kge = he.kge_2012(sim, target, remove_zero=True)
 984            rmse = he.rmse(sim, target)
 985            mare = hydroeval.evaluator(hydroeval.mare, sim, target)
 986            print("*-------------------*")
 987            print("KGE coefficient: " + str(round(float(kge), 2)))
 988            print("Nash–Sutcliffe coefficient: " + str(round(nash_sut, 2)))
 989            print("RMSE: " + str(round(float(rmse), 2)))
 990            print("MARE coefficient: " + str(round(float(mare), 2)))
 991            print("*-------------------*")
 992        else:
 993            sim = sim.resample(parameter.freq).sum()
 994            target = target.resample(parameter.freq).sum()
 995            nash_sut = he.nse(sim, target, remove_zero=True)
 996            kge = he.kge_2012(sim, target, remove_zero=True)
 997            rmse = he.rmse(sim, target)
 998            mare = hydroeval.evaluator(hydroeval.mare, sim, target)
 999            print("*-------------------*")
1000            print("** Model efficiency based on " + parameter.freq_long + " aggregates **")
1001            print("KGE coefficient: " + str(round(float(kge), 2)))
1002            print("Nash–Sutcliffe coefficient: " + str(round(nash_sut, 2)))
1003            print("RMSE: " + str(round(float(rmse), 2)))
1004            print("MARE coefficient: " + str(round(float(mare), 2)))
1005            print("*-------------------*")
1006    else:
1007        kge = str("No observations available to calculate model efficiency coefficients.")
1008
1009    # if obs is not None:
1010    dat_stats = copy.deepcopy(output_MATILDA)
1011    dat_stats.loc[dat_stats.isnull().any(axis=1), :] = np.nan
1012    stats = create_statistics(dat_stats)
1013
1014    print(stats)
1015    print("End of the MATILDA simulation")
1016    print("---")
1017    output_MATILDA = output_MATILDA.round(3)
1018    output_all = [output_MATILDA, kge, stats, lookup_table, glacier_change_area]
1019
1020    return output_all
