1432def psample(
1433    df,
1434    obs,
1435    rep=10,
1436    output=None,
1437    dbname="matilda_par_smpl",
1438    dbformat=None,
1439    obj_func=None,
1440    opt_iter=False,
1441    fig_path=None,  # savefig=False,
1442    set_up_start=None,
1443    set_up_end=None,
1444    sim_start=None,
1445    sim_end=None,
1446    freq="D",
1447    lat=None,
1448    area_cat=None,
1449    area_glac=None,
1450    ele_dat=None,
1451    ele_glac=None,
1452    ele_cat=None,
1453    glacier_profile=None,
1454    interf=4,
1455    freqst=2,
1456    parallel=False,
1457    cores=2,
1458    save_sim=True,
1459    elev_rescaling=True,
1460    glacier_only=False,
1461    obs_type="annual",
1462    target_mb=None,
1463    target_swe=None,
1464    swe_scaling=None,
1465    algorithm="lhs",
1466    obj_dir="maximize",
1467    fix_param=None,
1468    fix_val=None,
1469    demcz_args: dict = None,  # DEMCz settings
1470    **kwargs,
1471):
1472    """
1473    Run parameter sampling for the MATILDA model using SPOTPY.
1474
1475    This function sets up a SPOTPY sampling routine for parameter optimization or sensitivity analysis.
1476    It supports parallel and serial computation, custom objective functions, and a variety of SPOTPY algorithms.
1477
1478    Parameters
1479    ----------
1480    df : pandas.DataFrame
1481        Input data for the MATILDA model.
1482    obs : pandas.DataFrame or str
1483        Observed data as a DataFrame or a file path to a CSV file containing observations.
1484    rep : int, optional
1485        Number of sampling repetitions (default is 10).
1486    output : str, optional
1487        Path to save the output files (default is None).
1488    dbname : str, optional
1489        Name of the database for saving results (default is 'matilda_par_smpl').
1490    dbformat : str, optional
1491        Format for the SPOTPY database (e.g., 'csv', 'sql'). Default is None (no database saved).
1492    obj_func : callable, optional
1493        Custom objective function for parameter optimization. If None, defaults are used.
1494    opt_iter : bool, optional
1495        If True, samples the optimum number of iterations based on the setup (default is False).
1496    fig_path : str, optional
1497        Path to save generated plots (default is None).
1498    set_up_start, set_up_end : str, optional
1499        Start and end dates for the model setup period (e.g., '2000-01-01').
1500    sim_start, sim_end : str, optional
1501        Start and end dates for the simulation period.
1502    freq : str, optional
1503        Temporal resolution of the input data (default is 'D').
1504    lat : float, optional
1505        Latitude of the study area (used for potential evapotranspiration calculations).
1506    area_cat : float, optional
1507        Total catchment area in km².
1508    area_glac : float, optional
1509        Glacierized area in km².
1510    ele_dat, ele_glac, ele_cat : float, optional
1511        Elevations (mean, glacier, and catchment).
1512    glacier_profile : pandas.DataFrame, optional
1513        Glacier profile data for rescaling and optimization routines.
1514    interf : int, optional
1515        Inference factor for SPOTPY (default is 4).
1516    freqst : int, optional
1517        Frequency step for SPOTPY (default is 2).
1518    parallel : bool, optional
1519        If True, runs sampling in parallel using MPI (default is False).
1520    cores : int, optional
1521        Number of cores to use for parallel sampling (default is 2).
1522    save_sim : bool, optional
1523        Whether to save simulation results in the database (default is True).
1524    elev_rescaling : bool, optional
1525        If True, applies elevation-based rescaling for glacier simulations (default is True).
1526    glacier_only : bool, optional
1527        If True, runs sampling specifically for glacier-related parameters (default is False).
1528    obs_type : str, optional
1529        Type of observed data for glacier calibration ('annual', 'winter', or 'summer'). Default is 'annual'.
1530    target_mb : float, optional
1531        Target mass balance for glacier calibration (default is None).
1532    target_swe : float, optional
1533        Target snow water equivalent for calibration (default is None).
1534    swe_scaling : float, optional
1535        Scaling factor for snow water equivalent (default is None).
1536    algorithm : str, optional
1537        SPOTPY algorithm to use (e.g., 'lhs', 'mcmc', 'dream'). Default is 'lhs'.
1538    obj_dir : str, optional
1539        Direction of the objective function optimization ('maximize' or 'minimize'). Default is 'maximize'.
1540    fix_param : list of str, optional
1541        List of parameters to fix during sampling (default is None).
1542    fix_val : dict, optional
1543        Dictionary of fixed parameter values (default is None).
1544    demcz_args : dict, optional
1545        Additional arguments for the DEMCz algorithm (default is None).
1546    kwargs : dict, optional
1547        Additional parameters for the MATILDA model.
1548
1549    Returns
1550    -------
1551    dict
1552        Results of the sampling, including:
1553        - 'best_param': dict
1554            Best parameter set identified during sampling.
1555        - 'best_index': int
1556            Index of the best run in the SPOTPY results.
1557        - 'best_model_run': array
1558            Model output corresponding to the best parameter set.
1559        - 'best_objf': float
1560            Value of the objective function for the best parameter set.
1561        - 'best_simulation': pandas.Series (if applicable)
1562            Simulated time series corresponding to the best parameter set.
1563        - 'sampling_plot': matplotlib.Figure (if applicable)
1564            Iteration vs. objective function plot.
1565        - 'best_run_plot': matplotlib.Figure (if applicable)
1566            Best simulation vs. observed data plot.
1567        - 'par_uncertain_plot': matplotlib.Figure (if applicable)
1568            Parameter uncertainty plot.
1569
1570    Notes
1571    -----
1572    - This function uses the SPOTPY library for parameter sampling and optimization.
1573    - Parallel computation is supported for specific algorithms ('mc', 'lhs', 'fast', 'rope', 'sceua', 'demcz').
1574
1575    References
1576    ----------
1577    - SPOTPY library:
1578      - Houska, T., Kraft, P., Chamorro-Chavez, A., & Breuer, L. (2015). "SPOTting Model Parameters Using a Ready-Made
1579        Python Package." PLOS ONE, 10(12), 1-22. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0145180
1580      - GitHub repository: https://github.com/thouska/spotpy
1581    """
1582
1583    cwd = os.getcwd()
1584    if output is not None:
1585        os.chdir(output)
1586
1587    # Setup model class:
1588
1589    if glacier_only:
1590        setup = spot_setup_glacier(
1591            set_up_start=set_up_start,
1592            set_up_end=set_up_end,
1593            sim_start=sim_start,
1594            sim_end=sim_end,
1595            freq=freq,
1596            area_cat=area_cat,
1597            area_glac=area_glac,
1598            ele_dat=ele_dat,
1599            ele_glac=ele_glac,
1600            lat=lat,
1601            interf=interf,
1602            freqst=freqst,
1603            glacier_profile=glacier_profile,
1604            obs_type=obs_type,
1605            **kwargs,
1606        )
1607
1608    else:
1609        setup = spot_setup(
1610            set_up_start=set_up_start,
1611            set_up_end=set_up_end,
1612            sim_start=sim_start,
1613            sim_end=sim_end,
1614            freq=freq,
1615            area_cat=area_cat,
1616            area_glac=area_glac,
1617            ele_dat=ele_dat,
1618            ele_glac=ele_glac,
1619            ele_cat=ele_cat,
1620            lat=lat,
1621            interf=interf,
1622            freqst=freqst,
1623            glacier_profile=glacier_profile,
1624            elev_rescaling=elev_rescaling,
1625            target_mb=target_mb,
1626            fix_param=fix_param,
1627            fix_val=fix_val,
1628            target_swe=target_swe,
1629            swe_scaling=swe_scaling,
1630            **kwargs,
1631        )
1632
1633    psample_setup = setup(
1634        df, obs, target_swe, obj_func
1635    )  # Define custom objective function using obj_func=
1636    alg_selector = {
1637        "mc": spotpy.algorithms.mc,
1638        "sceua": spotpy.algorithms.sceua,
1639        "mcmc": spotpy.algorithms.mcmc,
1640        "mle": spotpy.algorithms.mle,
1641        "abc": spotpy.algorithms.abc,
1642        "sa": spotpy.algorithms.sa,
1643        "dds": spotpy.algorithms.dds,
1644        "demcz": spotpy.algorithms.demcz,
1645        "dream": spotpy.algorithms.dream,
1646        "fscabc": spotpy.algorithms.fscabc,
1647        "lhs": spotpy.algorithms.lhs,
1648        "padds": spotpy.algorithms.padds,
1649        "rope": spotpy.algorithms.rope,
1650        "fast": spotpy.algorithms.fast,
1651        "nsgaii": spotpy.algorithms.nsgaii,
1652    }
1653
1654    if target_mb is not None:  # Format errors in database csv when saving simulations
1655        save_sim = False
1656
1657    if parallel:
1658        sampler = alg_selector[algorithm](
1659            psample_setup,
1660            dbname=dbname,
1661            dbformat=dbformat,
1662            parallel="mpi",
1663            optimization_direction=obj_dir,
1664            save_sim=save_sim,
1665        )
1666        if algorithm in ("mc", "lhs", "fast", "rope"):
1667            sampler.sample(rep)
1668        elif algorithm == "sceua":
1669            sampler.sample(rep, ngs=cores)
1670        elif algorithm == "demcz":
1671            sampler.sample(rep, nChains=cores, **demcz_args)
1672        else:
1673            raise ValueError(
1674                "The selected algorithm is ineligible for parallel computing."
1675                'Either select a different algorithm (mc, lhs, fast, rope, sceua or demcz) or set "parallel = False".'
1676            )
1677    else:
1678        sampler = alg_selector[algorithm](
1679            psample_setup,
1680            dbname=dbname,
1681            dbformat=dbformat,
1682            save_sim=save_sim,
1683            optimization_direction=obj_dir,
1684        )
1685        if opt_iter:
1686            if yesno(
1687                f"\n******** WARNING! Your optimum # of iterations is {psample_setup.par_iter}. "
1688                "This may take a long time.\n******** Do you wish to proceed"
1689            ):
1690                sampler.sample(
1691                    psample_setup.par_iter
1692                )  # ideal number of reps = psample_setup.par_iter
1693            else:
1694                print(f"Proceeding with {rep} iterations.")
1695                sampler.sample(rep)
1696        else:
1697            sampler.sample(rep)
1698
1699    # Change dbformat to None for short tests but to 'csv' or 'sql' to avoid data loss in case off long calculations.
1700
1701    if target_mb is None:
1702        psample_setup.evaluation().to_csv(dbname + "_observations.csv")
1703    else:
1704        psample_setup.evaluation()[0].to_csv(dbname + "_observations.csv")
1705
1706    if fix_param is not None:
1707        print("Fixed parameters:\n")
1708        defaults = {
1709            "lr_temp": -0.006,
1710            "lr_prec": 0,
1711            "TT_snow": 0,
1712            "TT_diff": 2,
1713            "CFMAX_snow": 2.5,
1714            "CFMAX_rel": 2,
1715            "BETA": 1.0,
1716            "CET": 0.15,
1717            "FC": 250,
1718            "K0": 0.055,
1719            "K1": 0.055,
1720            "K2": 0.04,
1721            "LP": 0.7,
1722            "MAXBAS": 3.0,
1723            "PERC": 1.5,
1724            "UZL": 120,
1725            "PCORR": 1.0,
1726            "SFCF": 0.7,
1727            "CWH": 0.1,
1728            "AG": 0.7,
1729            "CFR": 0.15,
1730        }
1731        print_par = {}
1732        for p in fix_param:
1733            if p in fix_val:
1734                print_par[p] = fix_val[p]
1735            else:
1736                print_par[p] = defaults[p]
1737        for key, value in print_par.items():
1738            print(f"{key}: {value}")
1739        print("\nNOTE: Fixed parameters are not listed in the final parameter set.\n")
1740
1741    if not parallel:
1742
1743        if target_mb is None:
1744            results = analyze_results(
1745                sampler,
1746                psample_setup.evaluation(),
1747                algorithm=algorithm,
1748                obj_dir=obj_dir,
1749                fig_path=fig_path,
1750                dbname=dbname,
1751                glacier_only=glacier_only,
1752            )
1753        else:
1754            results = analyze_results(
1755                sampler,
1756                psample_setup.evaluation()[0],
1757                algorithm=algorithm,
1758                obj_dir=obj_dir,
1759                fig_path=fig_path,
1760                dbname=dbname,
1761                glacier_only=glacier_only,
1762                target_mb=target_mb,
1763            )
1764
1765        os.chdir(cwd)
1766
1767        return results
1768
1769    os.chdir(cwd)
1770
1771
1772def load_parameters(path, algorithm, obj_dir="maximize", glacier_only=False):
1773    """
1774    Load the best parameter set from SPOTPY sampling results.
1775
1776    This function retrieves the best parameter set from a SPOTPY sampling results file, based on the specified algorithm
1777    and objective function direction.
1778
1779    Parameters
1780    ----------
1781    path : str
1782        File path to the SPOTPY sampling results (e.g., 'results.csv').
1783    algorithm : str
1784        SPOTPY algorithm used for sampling (e.g., 'lhs', 'mcmc', 'dream').
1785    obj_dir : str, optional
1786        Direction of the objective function optimization ('maximize' or 'minimize'). Default is 'maximize'.
1787    glacier_only : bool, optional
1788        If True, processes only glacier-specific sampling results (default is False).
1789
1790    Returns
1791    -------
1792    dict
1793        A dictionary containing the best parameter set identified from the sampling results.
1794
1795    Notes
1796    -----
1797    - This function uses the `analyze_results` function to extract the best parameters.
1798    - It assumes that the corresponding observation file is named `<path_without_extension>_observations.csv`.
1799    - Depending on the number of samples loading of the sampling file might be slow.
1800
1801    References
1802    ----------
1803    - SPOTPY library:
1804      - Houska, T., Kraft, P., Chamorro-Chavez, A., & Breuer, L. (2015). "SPOTting Model Parameters Using a Ready-Made
1805        Python Package." PLOS ONE, 10(12), 1-22. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0145180
1806      - GitHub repository: https://github.com/thouska/spotpy
1807    """
1808
1809    sampling_csv = path
1810    sampling_obs = path.split(".")[0] + "_observations.csv"
1811    results = analyze_results(
1812        sampling_csv, sampling_obs, algorithm, obj_dir, glacier_only=glacier_only
1813    )
1814
1815    return results["best_param"]
1816

1818def get_par_bounds(path, threshold=10, percentage=True, drop=None):
1819    """
1820    Generate parameter bounds from SPOTPY sampling results.
1821
1822    This function extracts the minimum and maximum values of model parameters from the best-performing runs in
1823    SPOTPY sampling results. The best-performing runs are determined based on a likelihood threshold or percentage.
1824
1825    Parameters
1826    ----------
1827    path : str
1828        File path to the SPOTPY sampling results (e.g., 'results.csv').
1829    threshold : float, optional
1830        The threshold for selecting the best-performing runs:
1831        - If `percentage` is True, `threshold` represents the percentage of the top-performing runs to consider.
1832        - If `percentage` is False, `threshold` represents the numerical threshold for the objective function.
1833        Default is 10.
1834    percentage : bool, optional
1835        Determines whether to interpret `threshold` as a percentage (True) or a numerical threshold (False).
1836        Default is True.
1837    drop : list of str, optional
1838        A list of parameter names to exclude from the resulting bounds. Default is None.
1839
1840    Returns
1841    -------
1842    dict
1843        A dictionary containing the lower (`_lo`) and upper (`_up`) bounds for each parameter, derived from the
1844        best-performing runs.
1845
1846    Notes
1847    -----
1848    - The function loads SPOTPY sampling results and identifies the best-performing runs using the specified threshold
1849      and criteria.
1850    - Parameters specified in the `drop` list are excluded from the output bounds.
1851    - The resulting dictionary contains keys in the format `<parameter_name>_lo` and `<parameter_name>_up`.
1852
1853    References
1854    ----------
1855    - SPOTPY library:
1856      - Houska, T., Kraft, P., Chamorro-Chavez, A., & Breuer, L. (2015). "SPOTting Model Parameters Using a Ready-Made
1857        Python Package." PLOS ONE, 10(12), 1-22. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0145180
1858      - GitHub repository: https://github.com/thouska/spotpy
1859    """
1860    if drop is None:
1861        drop = []  # Initialize to an empty list if not provided
1862
1863    result_path = path
1864    results = spotpy.analyser.load_csv_results(result_path)
1865    # Get parameters of best model runs
1866    if percentage:
1867        best = spotpy.analyser.get_posterior(
1868            results, maximize=False, percentage=threshold
1869        )  # get best xx% runs
1870    else:
1871        best = results[
1872            np.where(results["like1"] <= threshold)
1873        ]  # get all runs below a treshhold
1874    params = spotpy.analyser.get_parameters(best)
1875    # Write min and max parameter values of best model runs to dictionary
1876    par_bounds = {}
1877    for i in spotpy.analyser.get_parameter_fields(best):
1878        p = params[i]
1879        par_bounds[i.split("par")[1] + "_lo"] = min(p)
1880        par_bounds[i.split("par")[1] + "_up"] = max(p)
1881    for i in drop:
1882        del par_bounds[i + "_lo"]
1883        del par_bounds[i + "_up"]
1884
1885    return par_bounds
